chapters.title: Chapter 5180: Information!
paragraphs: In Existence, there was something known as Murphy’s Law.Though in the higher reaches of THE Information Paradox, we recognize it as the inevitable manifestation of every catastrophic probability that has been seeded into the weavings of time.

If a configuration of events exists that can lead to the undoing of a Cause, then that configuration is not merely a possibility but a certainty that is already rushing toward its own realization, because information that can be written will eventually find its place upon the page of reality.

The truly wise do not seek comfort in the illusion of stability, for stability is merely the brief and deceptive silence before the storm of existence decides to correct itself through the most violent means available.

To exist is to be vulnerable to the absolute failure of every brittle foundation one has built, and only those who have looked into the depths of THE Worst Possibilities and found their anchors there can truly hope to survive when the weavings finally decide to go wrong.

Anything that can go wrong will go wrong, and it will do so with a clinical and devastating precision that cares nothing for the vanity of your preparations, leaving behind only the cold truth of what remains when THE Shroud of Certainty is stripped away from the bones of reality.
In THE Primordial Realm of Helheim.

The domain had changed as it unfolded as an expanse of stellar horror where the very concept of a horizon was replaced by a suffocating, lightless void that was punctuated only by the rhythmic, agonizing pulse of stars and Wheels of Existence that had long since forgotten how to radiate warmth.

Space here did not function as a vacuum but as a viscous, ink-like medium through which massive, obsidian tentacles of unfathomable length writhed with the slow and patient grace of ancient predators, their surfaces slick with the residue of forgotten civilizations and the crushed dreams of those who had dared to seek the truth of the end.

In the heart of this oddity, floating with a stillness that commanded the attention of the surrounding disturbances, was the titanic figure of THE Primordial Paradox, an obsidian titan whose seated posture carried the weight of eons of calculated uncertainty.

Behind his massive, mountain-like form stretched a mass of obsidian shadow that extended for light years into the reaches of the realm where even the most piercing perception could not find a conclusion, a darkness so profound that it seemed to be a living extension of the titan’s own mastery over the state of being and not being.

THE Primordial Paradox gazed behind him at the immense shadow with eyes that held the history of a thousand failed epochs, and his voice emerged with a heavy and resonant timbre that caused the writhing tentacles of Helheim to momentarily still their motion.

"We have fought and fought across the shifting tides of the paradox, my disciple, and yet I never truly believed that you would return to me for guidance again after you chose to walk the path of your own madness. As existence rolls down and expands into configurations that even I find increasingly difficult to quantify, did you finally find yourself missing the presence of your teacher, and what exactly happened to your existence to cause the emergence of such a heavy and suffocating presence within the depths of your own shadow?"

The silence that followed was not an absence of sound but a physical pressure that squeezed the local space, until a voice began to emerge from the lightless depths of the mass behind the titan, a voice that carried the ragged edge of a being who had been unmade and rewoven in the fires of a total contradiction.
This was THE Living Paradox, Erwin, yet the cadence of his speech had transitioned into something that felt like the grinding of tectonic plates beneath a sea of liquid information!

"The journey toward the culmination of my Cause... encountered a variable that was not permitted by any calculation I had spent eons perfecting, for my existence was almost entirely scorched and unmade by the absolute brilliance of the infinity wielded by Osmont. It was a fire that sought to erase the very information that defined me as a paradox, and as I felt the foundations of my body being reduced to nothingness during the struggle at Nakatsukuni, I realized that the only path toward survival was to latch even more onto the very information that was attempting to destroy me."
The shadow behind the titan began to undulate with a sudden, violent intensity, and the voice of Erwin grew deeper.

"By latching even further onto the information from Osmont, I found a collision between my paradox and his infinity that caused the very rules of existence to begin unraveling around me, creating a state where the laws of definition and undefinition were no longer able to maintain their separation. I am THE Information Paradox. Information is conserved within me. And yet, simultaneously, that information is lost forever in ways that should be impossible. I hold both states within myself at all times. I am the void that consumes, and I am the release that carries no trace. I said these exact words to Osmont before."
HUUM!

"I sought to become the fundamental Information upon which Observable Existence operates. To be the paradox at the heart of reality itself. The Information from Osmont and my destruction...dispersed me across Observable Existence before reforming me with boundless Information of the very nature of Existence. Of the very...Scales of Existence as I took in all their information! And from it...oh!"
A sense of madness bloomed from Erwin as he spoke.

"I...have gained the terrifying capability to eat the information about Vakochev’s Scales, to consume the very rules that dictate how power is quantified and measured across reality, which means that I am no longer a being who merely operates within the system, but a predator who feeds upon the code of the system itself. I even devoured bindings of The Information from a Gilded one trying to impose themselves on me and you as if it was the simplect thing in existence."

As he spoke, the shadow behind THE Primordial Paradox began to solidify into a shocking and chthonian-like manifestation, a creature composed of shifting, ink-black limbs and thousands of eyes that reflected the flickering data of Existence, its figure appearing as a living violation of every biological and existential law.

"The only downside to this absolute consumption is that the volume of information I have taken in is so vast that I found myself losing my anchor in reality, for a being who eats the rules must eventually find a singular truth to hold onto or be lost to the void of his own hunger. My Cause required an anchor, and I found it in the only piece of information that remains untainted by the paradox, which was my beginning as a mere peasant who was taken in by a master who saw potential in the dirt."
"I have come back to find you because you are my beginning and my anchor. The peasant asks for forgiveness. The peasant...will always remain a peasant. This is my anchor. This...will keep me sane."
The chthonian form of Erwin loomed behind his teacher, its presence now so immense that it seemed to rival the obsidian titan in its terrifying potential.

"Master and disciple could move together once again, just as we did when the first paradox was being woven from the threads of the unknown, and this time we shall not merely observe the turning of the scales. We shall move together to devour all information across existence, taking on THE Gilded and the Bounded...and everything else. Your disciple...wishes to come home, Master. I am taking in far too much information as I need a Living Anchor of my Cause. Your disciple...needs you."
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5181: Gilded! I
paragraphs: Seated upon the jagged edges of a multicolored shard of floating rock that drifted through the inverted and unpredictable currents of The Wandering Territories, Noah experienced the profound and transformative silence of THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity, a state that felt less like a mask he had donned and more like a fundamental realignment of his very soul.

When he took on this specific transformation, he actually felt as if his very thoughts and everything about his internal architecture were perfectly aligned with this one singular amplified ego, for the fierce and tyrannical ambition that usually drove him was replaced by a quiet and terrifying clarity that required no assertion of the self.

Even if he chose to speak out loud in this desolate and shimmering landscape, his voice came out filled with the gentle and patient qualities of this ego, his demeanor and his every movement radiating a quality of surrender that was an astonishing and glorious change to feel compared to his usual tyrannical and calculating self.

It was to the point that even as he waited for the arrival of the clandestine contact from THE Magna Sorora, he felt an unbound sense of patience as if whatever would arrive would arrive exactly when it was meant to arrive, a state of peace and serenity that he had never truly expected to find within the chaotic path of his own progression.

​As he waited, the hours began to pass with the slow and unhurried rhythm of the inverted light waterfalls nearby, and during these hours he utilized his reach to check on many things across the expanding horizons of his influence.

He checked on Alexander and THE Great Usurper, who had not asked for his intervention despite the monumental changes that had unfolded across THE Wyld, as they seemed to be dealing with the shifting circumstances on their own terms with a resilience that satisfied his expectations.

Even THE Primordial Paradox did not ask anything of him when Noah reached out across their shared understanding, for the ancient being stated with a detached calm that he was currently dealing with something paradoxical on his own and required no external support to maintain his standing.

​A tremendous number of things continued to occur within the depths of THE Infiniverse during this quiet time, as Noah continued to outline the transformations that his people could eventually go through while uniquely designing their Hadean engineering based on the data he was learning from reverse-engineering the inner components of the Gilded Gerousia.

During these passing hours, he monitored the many activities within his domain and the movements of his allies, but eventually he raised his eyes filled with a terrifying and quiet humility toward the sky, for he felt the very fabric of the Wyld begin to shatter under the weight of an arrival that surpassed the previous descent of Elzyana.

Terrifying auras of Gilded Ones began to descend in a storm of gold and authority, their figures manifesting with a structural complexity that spoke of eons of existential engineering, and Noah watched with a clinical eye as the rigid hierarchy of their civilization revealed itself in the sky.

He sensed ten Superbius Gilded Ones who were wearing regal golden clothing and shining with a pride that sought to overwrite the very air they occupied, their every movement conveying the casual inevitability of those who were born to rule without question.

They were accompanied by twenty Ira Gilded Ones who wore heavy crimson armaments and radiated a profound and violent wrath, yet even these martial enforcers stood with a respectful distance from the Superbius, acting as the sharp blades in the hands of their sovereign masters.
"Ho?"
He had not seen this many Gilded Ones before as their interactions revealed new things!

Following these were five hundred Gula Gilded Ones burning with authority, their figures being either regally fat or immensely muscular while draped in silver robes that shimmered with the essence of their industrial gluttony, and finally a thousand Luxuria Gilded Ones.

These Luxuria were adorned in pink and possessed a beauty that was so unfathomable it threatened to unweave the senses of any Bounded lifeform who dared to gaze upon them, yet Noah noticed with a calm heart that they stood as nothing more than living ornaments, their engineered forms positioned to maximize the aesthetic splendor of others they served.

As soon as this many Gilded Ones arrived, space fluctuated with a sudden and intense ripple as eight Sororis also arrived from the higher domains, all of them uniquely shining with a brand of Superbius Pride that marked them as daughters of THE Magna Sorora.

Noah observed the mannerisms of these sovereign women as they landed, noting how they spoke only to the ten Superbius males and females as if they were the only entities in the sky worthy of horizontal communication, while the Ira warriors stood in a state of aggressive readiness that required no orders to maintain.

The Superbius issued directives to others with the same disregard a man might show to the tools in his workshop, and Noah watched as the Gula and Luxuria moved with a total lack of independent ego to fulfill the requirements of the occupation!

Multiple parties began to coalesce with the clinical efficiency of a deployment, where a single Superbius Gilded One stood at the vanguard while the crimson-clad Ira followed behind as the instruments of their will, and the silver-robed Gula and the radiant Luxuria were distributed as the necessary infrastructure for the coming era of change!
Noah’s expression became calm and heavy as he watched the scale of the deployment through the eyes of his dispersed Infinity.
He did not expect so fucking many Gilded Ones!

As Noah tracked the movements of THE Gilded forces that were even now carving their names into the substrate of THE Wyld, he sensed space cracking open a few gigaparsecs away from his current coordinate within the inverted reaches of the Wandering Territories, for another Gilded One had descended away from the main deployment.

This newcomer appeared directly within the shimmering and chaotic valleys of the Territories, and when she emerged from the fractured reality, Noah observed her as she spread a veiled aura out across the local space as if she were searching for a specific signature that had been promised to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 5182: Gilded! II
paragraphs: He recognized that this was likely the contact Ubergulden Adelheid had sent to facilitate his passage, and he noted with interest that even as she searched, she was masking her own power and presence with a degree of sophistication that suggested she did not want her presence in this region to be noted by the other sisters of THE Magna Sorora.

He felt her aura pass through the very region where he sat upon his floating debris, yet even as the searchlight of her perception swept over his coordinates, she did not sense him at all, her gaze continuing to move across the horizon without finding the target she had been dispatched to retrieve.

Noah smiled brilliantly within the quietude of his own mind because he truly enjoyed the sensation of a Sororis being unable to perceive him even when he was sitting directly before her, and he found the absolute effectiveness of the Humilitas Ego to be a glorious validation of his recent engineering.

He decided that he had seen enough of her capacity, and he made the deliberate intention to allow his aura and his being to be perceived by her perception alone, allowing his presence to bleed back into the observable from the state of total invisibility.
HUUM!

He became visible to her perception in a single instant of reappearing light, and the response from the Gilded visitor was immediate as she looked over in his direction and took a single step that warped the space between them!
WU!

She appeared in front of Noah right away, her figure manifesting with the sudden and heavy weight of a mountain of compressed authority, and this ally of Ubergulden Adelheid looked at him up and down with a cold and judgmental focus!

Noah remained seated with a calm smile, his Humilitas Ego projecting a quality of serene and unassuming depth as he mirrored her actions by looking her over in return, noting that her attire was a grand display of sovereign elegance that surpassed even the regal presentation of Elzyana.

She was adorned in an exquisite golden sari of draped silk that flowed around her form like a river of molten sunlight, and her existence was further embellished with vibrant accessories of heavy necklaces and radiant jewels that chimed with a subtle and dangerous resonance.

Her power felt even heavier than that of Sororis Prima Elzyana, suggesting a standing within the Sisterhood that commanded a terrifying degree of respect, and she stood before him with the posture of a ruler who found the current environment to be beneath her station.
In the next moment, she broke the silence with a voice that was as cold as the void between the realms, introducing herself with a cadence that allowed for no ambiguity.
"I am Maharanis Prabhavati, or in the terminology of THE Magna Sorora that you might be more familiar with, Sororis Prima Prabhavati."
Noah looked at her with his unique and humble disposition, his eyes reflecting a quiet curiosity that held no trace of the tyrannical pride he usually broadcasted to his enemies.
"I am Osmont, THE Weaver of Existence, and I find myself wondering...why you choose to carry the two distinctions of Maharanis and Sororis."
Sororis Prima Prabhavati looked at him coldly, and she answered him with a clinical and detached explanation.

"I am Maharanis because I belong to a distinguished and ancient house within THE Braneworld Observable Existence, a standing that is similar to the one held by Ubergulden Adelheid who stems from the lineage of the Ubergulden house, but I am also Sororis because my identity as a sister of THE Magna Sorora is equally important to the architecture of my life."
WAA!

"I have come to this desolate region and searched for you specifically to see exactly what kind of Bounded Lifeform would be capable of convincing my childhood friend to risk her very life and the status of her house, for I have been asking myself if you would be some unfathomably handsome existence or perhaps a being who had gained an incredible degree of power to make you stand out among the dross. Yet as I look at you now...I sense nothing of value, for I do not even perceive the weavings of power that should accompany a being of your supposed significance."
She stepped closer, the radiant jewels around her neck pulsing with a dim and threatening light that mirrored the rising tension in her gaze.

"Do you truly know the position she holds and do you comprehend what all of this clandestine maneuvering means for her if the truth were to be discovered by THE Gilded houses? Do you understand the certain death that will be granted to her if you were to be found out, and do you realize that... I should likely just kill you right now to end her problems early before your insignificance causes her ultimate ruin?"
BOOM!

Noah let out a soft and melodic laugh that carried the gentle weight of a stream flowing over smooth stones, his eyes remaining entirely calm even as the killing intent from the Sororis pressed against the local space.

He looked at her with a laid back expression that seemed entirely at odds with the gravity of her threat, for his current state of Humilitas allowed him to view the prospect of his own demise with a serenity that bordered on the absolute.

"I find myself genuinely curious whether a Sororis of your standing possesses the capacity to erase a being such as myself from the weavings of existence, though I think we shall not find the answer to that question today because you have made a promise to your childhood friend. Rather than wasting our time with threats of a death that would only serve to break poor Ubergulden Adelheid’s heart, tell me more about the grand arrangement of your kind, for I watched hundreds of Gilded Ones descend upon Observable Existence only moments ago and saw the arrogant manner in which the Superbius issued their commands to the rest of the host. Are THE Gilded truly so divided in their standing?"
Sororis Prima Prabhavati adjusted the golden silk of her sari, her radiant jewels pulsing with a soft and haughty light as she looked down at him.
To her, the questions he asked were so fundamental that the mere fact he needed them answered was a testament to the primitive nature of his origins!

"It is not a matter of division in the sense of a flaw, but rather a masterpiece of absolute order that ensures the stability of many Observable Existences through the glorious right of the Superbius Houses. For we are the sovereign planners and the faces of civilization who have been engineered with the most refined Pride to lead."
BOOM!

"Beneath our guidance, the Ira serve as our glorious and unyielding blades while the Avaritia maintain the archives of our wisdom and the wealth of our reach, and the Invidia watch for any deviation from this perfect harmony to ensure that no discord ever disrupts the beauty of our arrangement."

"Even the lower tiers find their truest purpose within this hierarchy, as the Acedia remain as the immovable anchors of our infrastructure while the Gula and Luxuria find their truest fulfillment in providing the labor and the pleasure that allow the higher designations to focus on the governance of Existence and war against THE Relictus. To a Bounded mind like yours, it may appear as a cold stratification, but in truth, it is the highest form of compassion to grant every being a designation that perfectly matches their engineered essence, for what could be more merciful than ensuring a Luxuria never has to suffer the burden of a decision she was never meant to make while she basks in the reflected glory of the Superbius she serves?"

Noah remained seated with a calm smile, his Humilitas Ego projecting a quality of serene and unassuming depth as he mirrored her actions by looking her over in return, noting that her attire was a grand display of sovereign elegance that surpassed even the regal presentation of Elzyana.

She was adorned in an exquisite golden sari of draped silk that flowed around her form like a river of molten sunlight, and her existence was further embellished with vibrant accessories of heavy necklaces and radiant jewels that chimed with a subtle and dangerous resonance.

Her power felt even heavier than that of Sororis Prima Elzyana, suggesting a standing within the Sisterhood that commanded a terrifying degree of respect, and she stood before him with the posture of a ruler who found the current environment to be beneath her station.
In the next moment, she broke the silence with a voice that was as cold as the void between the realms, introducing herself with a cadence that allowed for no ambiguity.
"I am Maharanis Prabhavati, or in the terminology of THE Magna Sorora that you might be more familiar with, Sororis Prima Prabhavati."
Noah looked at her with his unique and humble disposition, his eyes reflecting a quiet curiosity that held no trace of the tyrannical pride he usually broadcasted to his enemies.
"I am Osmont, THE Weaver of Existence, and I find myself wondering...why you choose to carry the two distinctions of Maharanis and Sororis."
Sororis Prima Prabhavati looked at him coldly, and she answered him with a clinical and detached explanation.

"I am Maharanis because I belong to a distinguished and ancient house within THE Braneworld Observable Existence, a standing that is similar to the one held by Ubergulden Adelheid who stems from the lineage of the Ubergulden house, but I am also Sororis because my identity as a sister of THE Magna Sorora is equally important to the architecture of my life."
WAA!

"I have come to this desolate region and searched for you specifically to see exactly what kind of Bounded Lifeform would be capable of convincing my childhood friend to risk her very life and the status of her house, for I have been asking myself if you would be some unfathomably handsome existence or perhaps a being who had gained an incredible degree of power to make you stand out among the dross.
Yet as I look at you now...I sense nothing of value, for I do not even perceive the weavings of power that should accompany a being of your supposed significance."
She stepped closer, the radiant jewels around her neck pulsing with a dim and threatening light that mirrored the rising tension in her gaze.
"Do you truly know the position she holds and do you comprehend what all of this clandestine maneuvering means for her if the truth were to be discovered by THE Gilded houses?
Do you understand the certain death that will be granted to her if you were to be found out, and do you realize that...
I should likely just kill you right now to end her problems early before your insignificance causes her ultimate ruin?"
BOOM!

Noah let out a soft and melodic laugh that carried the gentle weight of a stream flowing over smooth stones, his eyes remaining entirely calm even as the killing intent from the Sororis pressed against the local space.

He looked at her with a laid back expression that seemed entirely at odds with the gravity of her threat, for his current state of Humilitas allowed him to view the prospect of his own demise with a serenity that bordered on the absolute.

"I find myself genuinely curious whether a Sororis of your standing possesses the capacity to erase a being such as myself from the weavings of existence, though I think we shall not find the answer to that question today because you have made a promise to your childhood friend.

Rather than wasting our time with threats of a death that would only serve to break poor Ubergulden Adelheid’s heart, tell me more about the grand arrangement of your kind, for I watched hundreds of Gilded Ones descend upon Observable Existence only moments ago and saw the arrogant manner in which the Superbius issued their commands to the rest of the host.
Are THE Gilded truly so divided in their standing?"
Sororis Prima Prabhavati adjusted the golden silk of her sari, her radiant jewels pulsing with a soft and haughty light as she looked down at him.
To her, the questions he asked were so fundamental that the mere fact he needed them answered was a testament to the primitive nature of his origins!

"It is not a matter of division in the sense of a flaw, but rather a masterpiece of absolute order that ensures the stability of many Observable Existences through the glorious right of the Superbius Houses.
For we are the sovereign planners and the faces of civilization who have been engineered with the most refined Pride to lead."
BOOM!

"Beneath our guidance, the Ira serve as our glorious and unyielding blades while the Avaritia maintain the archives of our wisdom and the wealth of our reach, and the Invidia watch for any deviation from this perfect harmony to ensure that no discord ever disrupts the beauty of our arrangement."

"Even the lower tiers find their truest purpose within this hierarchy, as the Acedia remain as the immovable anchors of our infrastructure while the Gula and Luxuria find their truest fulfillment in providing the labor and the pleasure that allow the higher designations to focus on the governance of Existence and war against THE Relictus.

To a Bounded mind like yours, it may appear as a cold stratification, but in truth, it is the highest form of compassion to grant every being a designation that perfectly matches their engineered essence, for what could be more merciful than ensuring a Luxuria never has to suffer the burden of a decision she was never meant to make while she basks in the reflected glory of the Superbius she serves?"

chapters.title: Chapter 5183: Crack A Gilded One! I
paragraphs: Noah looked at this terrifying woman in front of him with a sense of cold serenity as he thought about her words, wondering if the same existential overwriting he’d seen in Bounded lifeforms applied to the masters themselves.

He’d seen how the Gilded could rewrite the very minds of those they touched, forcing even the most powerful Primordial Architects to revere the Superbius as a fact of nature, and he couldn’t help but speculate if this entire civilization was just a massive lattice of engineered obedience where even the strongest were bound by the strings of their caste.

It was a dark, pragmatic thought that most wouldn’t dare to entertain while standing before a Sororis Prima, but Noah wasn’t most people, and he watched the Maharanis with the detached curiosity of a man looking at a particularly complex and monstrous puppet.

As he was thinking this, Sororis Prima Prabhavati continued to look at him up and down before she shook her head and let out a long, weary sigh that suggested he was a burden she’d rather see discarded.

"While I cannot fathom what Ubergulden Adelheid sees in you, I will keep my promise to her and design a new identity for your existence, because she doesn’t have much time before THE Magna Sorora will demand an answer from her regardless of her noble house. You have to go now, for I have to remain among the other sisters to close off the bases of this Observable and observe the process, since it seems we cannot leave Bounded lifeforms alone without them becoming ungrateful. We tried to give you an entire existence to yourselves while we remained in the Braneworld, occasionally coming down to bless you with our presence, and yet you’ve chosen to house a Relictus among your ranks."
She adjusted the golden silk of her sari with a sharp, dismissive movement that caused her radiant jewels to chime with a hollow resonance.

"Ah, it’s no matter, for my Custos will finish everything I’ve set up, and since the both of you are technically Custodes, she can get you up to speed on exactly what you need to be and do to survive the crossing. Little Rani, come out and take charge of this Weaver."
The skies above the Wandering Territories shattered once more with a sudden, crystalline violence that made Noah raise his eyes to the heavens.

Someone pristinely powerful began to descend from the fracture, her presence casting a soft pink radiance that contrasted sharply with the multicolored chaos of the region. Sororis Prima Prabhavati saw his reaction and offered a cold, thin smile of her own as the figure approached.

"What, did you think Custodes could only be men? This is mine, and I assure you she’s more capable than any Ira Custos you might encounter, for she’ll be the one to ensure your successful transition into the Braneworld."

The Custos who descended was a unique existence, a woman radiating a calm and overwhelming beauty while draped in flowing pink robes that clung to a figure that was curvaceous and full in every proportion. She possessed a physical allure that could likely topple civilizations if she chose to weaponize it, her ears being slightly pointy and delicate while hazy pink-white wings unfurled behind her to stabilize her descent.
Her eyes were perhaps the most striking feature of all, for they shone like clusters of galaxies held within a sea of violet.
She smiled and bowed toward Sororis Prima Prabhavati with a deep sense of reverence, but then she turned to Noah and shockingly offered the same smile and a respectful bow to him as well.

A Gilded One, especially one of this tier, bowing at him was a development he hadn’t fully anticipated. He watched her calmly, for while she was undeniably beautiful, he’d seen beauty in every form imaginable throughout his life, and in his current state of THE Humilitas Ego of Infinity, the seductive charm of the Luxuria designation did absolutely nothing to his internal focus!
She stood upright and gestured toward the horizon where the boundaries between domains were beginning to blur.

"Please, follow me, for I’ll be the one guiding your path from this point forward. Maharanis Prabhavati, you can trust me to take care of everything from here and ensure the Weaver...reaches his destination as intended."
After those words, the Custos waved her hand upward in a grand, sweeping motion, and a shimmering rainbow-colored river began to ascend from the valley toward the shattered skies above.

Noah looked at Sororis Prima Prabhavati, who continued to gaze at him with a cold and judgmental focus as he stepped onto the multicolored flow, and Rani followed closely behind him after offering one final, subordinate bow to her mistress.

The moment he stepped onto the river, Noah felt his perception uniquely changing. He actually felt a sensation of power that he most closely remembered to be stemming from a grand Cause, as if A Pulse of THE Scales was being activated to pull from a segment of THE First Cause itself.

Reality twisted and distorted around him until his body felt like it was disappearing from the Territories and from every region he’d grown familiar with, his surroundings dissolving into a blur of speed and authority.
HUUM!

In an instant, he found himself traversing across a domain of tumultuous crimson-pink clouds, feeling as if he were traveling within a vessel made of the very clouds themselves, and he realized the substance was a direct manifestation of the Custos’s power.
His smile of humility remained fixed even as dazzling system prompts began to appear in front of his eyes, the text glowing with the weight of a new and sovereign jurisdiction.
|You have entered a personalized domain backed by THE Desidero Cause.|
|Your existence has temporarily ceased to reside within the standard coordinates of Observable Existence.|
|You are currently traversing a transitional space covered by the light of the aforementioned Cause inside a pathway designed to bring you to The Braneworld Observable Existence.|
He was in a space between spaces, a transitional area between where he’d been and where he was going, yet in the next moment, the domain around him began to churn and solidify with a sudden violence.

The clouds coalesced into a wide area filled with crimson-pink skies and a white sea below his feet, the edges of the space stretching out for a single light-year before being cut off by a wall of tumultuous vapor.
Everything came to a sudden, jarring stop as the forward momentum of the rainbow river vanished entirely, leaving Noah standing at the center of the silent, pink-lit void.
Noah kept his calm smile and turned around to see Custos Rani, his head tilted slightly in a gesture of unassuming curiosity.
"I wonder why we’ve stopped, for I was under the impression that we were on a very tight schedule."
Behind him, Custos Rani was no longer bowed in a gesture of service, for she was now floating with a devilish light in her galaxy-filled eyes while a crimson aura began to fill the entire space.
She offered him a dangerous smile that carried the full weight of her engineered Lust, her posture radiating an authority that was no longer hidden beneath the mask of a guide!

"Maharanis Prabhavati gave me very specific instructions for you, because she doesn’t trust a Bounded lifeform to ensure that her closest friend stays safe during the coming hours. I, Custos Rani, was deemed ideal for the task of bringing you under our total control, and within this space, we’ll make the required modifications and engineering on your worthless Bounded structure. We might even fuse you to the body of a dead Ira Gilded One to make you a decent enough shell to be a Custos of the great Ubergulden House, for a Bounded man has no place in the higher domains as he is."
BOOM!

Her smile was cold and deadly and filled with a seductive malice that would have shattered the consciousness of any other Bounded lifeform, for her aura was designed to make the mind surrender before the body was even touched.
And yet, Noah, in his boundlessly surging humility, couldn’t help but smile brilliantly in return!
Adversity had come for him once again, and yet his heart blazed with the expectation of what he was about to do to this Gilded doll.
"Fusing me to a corpse?" he murmured, his voice as soft as a summer breeze. "What a fascinatingly shitty idea."
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5184: Crack A Gilded One! II
paragraphs: He was wondering exactly where his power currently resided after he had elevated so much in that short span of time since he first met a Gilded One, for the pace of his growth had been a violent sprint that left the very foundations of his previous weavings in the dust.

He thought that he might be at the transitional stage if not nearing the power of a Third Scale entity, but he always liked to underestimate himself so that whenever he met a truly terrifying enemy, he could face them without a single flicker of fear in his Hadean heart.

The one behind him right now was not any mere Third Scale entity but a Gilded One whose very basal form of life was countless times grander than any Bounded Lifeform, and as the air within the transitional domain began to thicken with a rank, sweet musk, a terrifying pressure and radiation began to emanate from her body.
The radiation bloomed outward like a physical wave of suffocating desire, a heat that didn’t burn the skin but sought to melt the very concept of the self into a pool of submissive filth.

This existential radiation alone was enough to take down any entity within the Second Scale of existence, their civilizational weavings unraveling as they surrendered their sovereignty to the source of the light, but as it reached the coordinate where Noah sat, it encountered a stillness that was absolute!
|The Luxuria Existential Radiation is pressing down on your existence.|

|Targeting your civilization and your ego, this radiation is designed to warp your foundational instructions into a state of total servitude where your sole purpose becomes loving and serving the Luxuria Gilded One.|

|Common Third Scale Entities would find their autonomy erased by this engineered lust, yet because you are currently embodying THE Absolute Humilitas Ego of Infinity, you have attained total immunity to these effects.|

Noah’s eyes shone with a boundless and quiet humility as Custos Rani moved over toward him with the confidence of a predator who believed her prey had already been broken by the mere scent of her power.

She floated until she was only inches away from his face, the smell of her skin like a mixture of honey and the copper tang of fresh blood, and she used her hand to raise his head by putting her fingers on his chin as if she were touching a vile and lesser thing that she had just bought at a market.

"While your face is not bad, you are far too plain and meek for my personal tastes, though right now you are merely akin to a drop of sand inside a tiny domain while I am a brilliant sun. Be happy to even be basking in my presence as it should be giving you immense pleasure, for I’ve locked down this entire place to ensure that the bond you have with Ubergulden Adelheid is muted. Any Custos can call out to their Sororis, but this space we are in stops that signal to ensure you don’t ruin our plans, so tell me, you vile tiny thing, who...do you love most in existence?"

She spoke with a prideful and heavy lust, her eyes shining with the predatory hunger of an existence that had gotten its claws into the souls of countless others, and she even ran her hands down Noah’s chest and further down as if she were already claiming the meat of his body for her own entertainment.

Noah watched her with a serene calm for a heartbeat longer before his expression shifted into something brutal and terrifying, his entire existence transitioning from the silence of humility into the roaring ocean of boundless pride!
DUM! DUM! DUM!
His hand shot out with the speed of a kinetic strike and grasped onto her slender neck, the sound of his fingers tightening like iron bands around her throat echoing through the pink-lit void.
"I sure as hell don’t love you the most in existence, but I wonder if I can make you bleed today, and I wonder if I can finally bridge the gap between a Bounded man and a Gilded doll..."

Before she could even register the shift in his aura, he clamped down on her neck and smashed her body down onto the surface below them, his golden pride already beginning to permeate the surroundings and insert itself as the supreme law of the domain.

He made the surface unfathomably solid through the weight of his will, and the golden space below cracked and splintered as the body of a Gilded One was slammed into it with enough force to shatter a Primordial Realm, the sound of the impact being a wet and heavy thud that demanded acknowledgment!
|You have successfully transformed into THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity.|
|Your existence is now broadcasting THE Supremacy Radiation, and THE Sovereign Overwrite is currently active within the local substrate.|
Noah looked down to see that shockingly, Custos Rani appeared entirely uninjured and unbothered, her Gilded power rendering the physical impact into nothing but a minor inconvenience!
She only looked at him with an expression of pure incredulity as she blinked her galaxy-filled eyes, her pink robes slightly ruffled as she realized that her radiation had failed to take hold!
"You...resisted my radiation? You, a mere bounded thing, successfully resisted my charms and dared to lay your hands upon my person?!"
Noah rose to his full height and let go of her neck, allowing his tyrannical pride to surge around him in visible waves of molten gold and obsidian light.

He stretched his limbs as if he knew he was about to have a grand and satisfying battle, his figure radiating a regal and terrifying beauty that made the pink clouds of the domain seem pale and insignificant by comparison.

"I can give you a chance to try again, little Gilded one, though I have to admit I’m disappointed, for I’ve been with many women in my time and I never expected one with an amplified Ego of Luxuria to be so tasteless and without any real charm. You only seem to be a common whore that is somewhat clean, so I find myself wondering if a Gilded One of your station will truly be able to give me a challenge worth my time."

Every single word and every single mannerism about him right now emanated such a profound level of pride that even the space around him seemed to bow, and the eyes of Custos Rani began to shake with a violent and mounting rage!
She began to laugh madly as she lay on that transformed golden floor, her voice becoming a booming and cracked thing that filled the transitional space with the sound of a Gilded One losing her mind!
"Wow! Wow Wow WOW! To be talked down to by a piece of Bounded bacteria! Wow! Fuck, you can just die now!"
BOOM!

The true power of a Gilded One unfurled at that moment as multiple Pulses of THE Scales bloomed around her in a blinding display of golden light, the existential radiation of her lust spreading out like a tidal wave as the surrounding structure began to warp into a landscape of her choosing!
HUUM!
And yet, even in the face of this existential pressure, Noah smiled brutally with a pride that reached for the throat of the stars.
"Today is a good day...it is a good day to crack a Gilded One, a truly good day, so let me see what you’ve got!"
BOOM!

An unfathomable pride burning with infinity surged out from his core as Quintessence Infiniforce endlessly bloomed around him in a suffocating and terrifying fashion, looking like a storm that would drown everything in its path!

The change that was being made in the surroundings by her radiation began to get reversed by the weight of his Sovereignty, the pink clouds being torn apart to reveal forming suns and stellar bodies that radiated with his own tyrannical light.

Noah stood dominantly in the center of the chaos, his eyes shining with the cold and brilliant fire of Nearu Absolute Infinity, and even as Custos Rani began to summon Pulses of THE Scales, he only moved forward with the hunger of a king who had finally found a meal worth eating!

She only looked at him with an expression of pure incredulity as she blinked her galaxy-filled eyes, her pink robes slightly ruffled as she realized that her radiation had failed to take hold!
"You...resisted my radiation?
You, a mere bounded thing, successfully resisted my charms and dared to lay your hands upon my person?!"
Noah rose to his full height and let go of her neck, allowing his tyrannical pride to surge around him in visible waves of molten gold and obsidian light.

He stretched his limbs as if he knew he was about to have a grand and satisfying battle, his figure radiating a regal and terrifying beauty that made the pink clouds of the domain seem pale and insignificant by comparison.

"I can give you a chance to try again, little Gilded one, though I have to admit I’m disappointed, for I’ve been with many women in my time and I never expected one with an amplified Ego of Luxuria to be so tasteless and without any real charm.
You only seem to be a common whore that is somewhat clean, so I find myself wondering if a Gilded One of your station will truly be able to give me a challenge worth my time."

Every single word and every single mannerism about him right now emanated such a profound level of pride that even the space around him seemed to bow, and the eyes of Custos Rani began to shake with a violent and mounting rage!
She began to laugh madly as she lay on that transformed golden floor, her voice becoming a booming and cracked thing that filled the transitional space with the sound of a Gilded One losing her mind!
"Wow!
Wow Wow WOW!
To be talked down to by a piece of Bounded bacteria!
Wow!
Fuck, you can just die now!"
BOOM!

The true power of a Gilded One unfurled at that moment as multiple Pulses of THE Scales bloomed around her in a blinding display of golden light, the existential radiation of her lust spreading out like a tidal wave as the surrounding structure began to warp into a landscape of her choosing!
HUUM!
And yet, even in the face of this existential pressure, Noah smiled brutally with a pride that reached for the throat of the stars.
"Today is a good day...it is a good day to crack a Gilded One, a truly good day, so let me see what you’ve got!"
BOOM!

An unfathomable pride burning with infinity surged out from his core as Quintessence Infiniforce endlessly bloomed around him in a suffocating and terrifying fashion, looking like a storm that would drown everything in its path!

The change that was being made in the surroundings by her radiation began to get reversed by the weight of his Sovereignty, the pink clouds being torn apart to reveal forming suns and stellar bodies that radiated with his own tyrannical light.

Noah stood dominantly in the center of the chaos, his eyes shining with the cold and brilliant fire of Nearu Absolute Infinity, and even as Custos Rani began to summon Pulses of THE Scales, he only moved forward with the hunger of a king who had finally found a meal worth eating!

chapters.title: Chapter 5185: Crack A Gilded One! III
paragraphs: The silence of the transitional domain was shattered by the violent expansion of Custos Rani’s presence, her Gilded foundations roaring with a manic and bruised pride that turned the cloying, sweet musk of her radiation into a suffocating miasma!

She stood upon the golden floor that Noah had hardened with his sovereignty, her pink robes billowing like wings of tattered silk while the galaxy-filled clusters of her eyes burned with a light that was no longer seductive, but purely fucking predatory.
Her laughter was a jagged thing that grated against the immaculate silence of THE Absolute Forge’s influence, sounding like the grinding of broken glass beneath the heel of a titan.

She raised her left hand to her own lips and breathed across her fingertips with a gesture that was both delicate and horrifying, for the air she released was thick with the shimmering threads of...a Cause.
THE Desidero Cause.
"Desidero Ember, First of Wants,"she hissed, her voice vibrating with the raw power of a Gilded soul that had been pushed too far by a creature it considered beneath notice.
"I speak the Thread. I seed the Thread. What was content shall know its absence, and what was whole shall feel its fracture, so let the wanting commence where none existed. THE DESIDERO WHISPER!"
She extended her hand outward with her fingers splayed, the threads of implanted desire racing through the air like invisible serpents to strike at Noah’s existence!
|The subject is deploying THE Desidero Whisper, THE Pulse of Implanted Want, backed by the authority of THE Desidero Cause.|
|This Pulse attempts to integrate a foreign, crystallized desire into your foundational motivations to rewrite your emotional architecture from within.|

|Because you are currently embodying THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity, your Pride rejects the very possibility of external desire, for a sovereign being acknowledges no want that does not originate from his own will.|
Noah watched the shimmering threads dissipate against the invisible wall of his Supremacy Radiation, his expression one of dry and calculating amusement that only served to fuel the woman’s rage!
He could smell the ozone and the faint, metallic tang of the Desidero threads as they burned away in his presence, the scent reminding him of wet copper and old, forgottenregrets.

"Is that the best a Custodes can offer when their charms fail to produce a groveling slave?" he asked, his voice carrying the heavy and unhurried resonance of a monarch who found the entire spectacle to be a tedious interruption.
"You talked about bacteria and drops of sand, yet you’re the one breathing on your fingers and hoping that a few threads of wanting will make me forget that I held your Existence by the throat."
Rani’s face contorted into a mask of savage fury, her beauty curdling into a visceral horror as her aura flared with a crimson-gold light that began to liquefy the white sea beneath her feet!

She didn’t wait for another exchange of words, her arms raising above her head and bringing them down in a sweeping arc as she summoned a tide of invisible pressure that sought to drown the entire light-year of space!
"Desidero Torrent, Sea of Wants! I pour the Thread and I drown the Thread, for what was endurable shall overflow, and the wanting shall exceed the vessel that holds it! THE DESIDERO FLOOD!"
BOOM!

The domain was suddenly filled with an overwhelming surge of sensation that felt like every desire Noah had ever suppressed was being amplified to the intensity of a dying sun. It was a sensory overload of the highest order, a psychological siege that sought to fracture his consciousness by making every casual preference into a screaming, all-consuming compulsion that demanded immediate satisfaction!

Noah felt the pressure against his Superbius foundations, but he only stood his ground while the forming suns of his Quintessence Infiniforce began to burn with a more terrifying and suffocating brilliance.
He didn’t just resist the flood; he moved to consume the momentum of the attack, his own Nearu Absolute Infinity rising like a dark, crystalline tide to meet her golden torrent.
"A good day to crack a Gilded One indeed. Come!" he murmured, the words sounding like a promise delivered in the shadow of an executioner’s blade!
BOOM!

The multicolored brilliance of his Infiniforce bloomed outward in a terrifying fashion, the tyrannical pride of his Ego rewriting the pink clouds of the Desidero domain into landscapes of obsidian and cold, blue fire.

The change she had imposed was violently reversed as blinding stellar bodies began to form around Noah, their radiation broadcasting his supremacy with such intensity that the white sea began to evaporate into a mist of golden blood and dissolved information.

Noah stood at the center of the storm, his eyes shining with the cold fire of the Absolute, and he watched as the surprise in Rani’s galaxy-filled eyes turned into a flicker of genuine, visceral incredulity.

She summoned more Pulses of THE Scales around her as multiple Causes came to her defense, but the air was already thick with the smell of her pride starting to rot beneath the weight of a Bounded man!
"Let me see,"Noah whispered, his hand reaching out to grasp at the fabric of the transitional space itself.
"Let me see, for my Pride demands it!"
BOOM!
The transitional domain was no longer a place of quiet pink clouds and shimmering waterfalls, for it had become a claustrophobic slaughterhouse of competing authorities.
Custos Rani stood at the center of this localized apocalypse, her galaxy-filled eyes burning with a light that had moved past seduction and into the realm of absolute, unadulterated madness.

She commanded the architecture of the space to rise against the Bounded intruder, waving her hands in a grand, sweeping motion that summoned boundless rivers of golden Observable Force from the white sea below.

The rivers didn’t flow so much as they surged like starving predators, massive currents of liquid gold that carried the weight Causes, all of them aiming to drown Noah beneath the sheer, crushing mass of Gilded Luxuria authority.

Noah stood his ground as the first wave of the golden tide slammed into the perimeter of his sovereignty, the sound of the impact being a resonant, metallic boom that shook the foundations of the Desidero space.

He didn’t move an inch as the liquid gold curled around his figure, for the molten radiance simply bounced off the invisible wall of his Superbius Pride as if it were a common rain striking an obsidian mountain.
He let out a laugh that was thick with a glorious and terrifying pride, the sound echoing through the domain like the tolling of a funeral bell for the woman standing before him.

"Is this the ’brilliant sun’ you promised, little Gilded one?" he asked, his voice dripping with a dry and pragmatic disdain that made the golden rivers hiss and steam where they touched his aura, THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity truly unleashing itself.
"It feels more like a tepid bath...Custodes surely cannot be this weak. You must be one the weakest ones, right?"
|The target is utilizing Boundless Observable Force at the Third Scale capacity.|
|The golden rivers are attempting an Existential Drowning to overwrite your coordinates and compress your civilization.|
|Your Absolute Superbius Ego has identified these attacks as ’Insufficient.’|
|The Sovereign Overwrite is actively neutralizing the golden weavings upon contact, rendering their mass into harmless, unrefined energy.|
Rani’s face twisted into a mask of savage fury, her breath coming in ragged, wet gasps that smelled of honey and rot as she realized her primary manifestation was being treated as nothing but dross.

She surged forward with a speed that bypassed the need for traditional motion, her pink robes billowing like the wings of a predatory insect while her aura flared with a crimson-gold light that began to liquefy the air itself.
She unleashed THE Desidero Flood once more, but this time she infused the Pulse into her very hands and feet as she closed the distance for a brutal,close-quarters execution!

Her hands moved in a blurring flurry of strikes that targeted the vital nexuses of Noah’s existence, each hit carrying the weight of a dying existence and the suffocating pressure of her amplified Lust filled with boundless Luxuria Gilded Authority!
Noah met her head-on, his movements becoming a clinical display of his own foundations.
Physical? He could fucking get physical!

He didn’t back away as she unleashed a low, sweeping kick designed to shatter his shins, instead shifting his weight to catch the strike on the hardened obsidian pillar of his own leg, the sound of the collision being a sickening, wet crack of bone against iron!

He didn’t flinch as she tried to clinche his neck to deliver a series of devastating knees to his midsection, each one carrying the Immensity of her Pulses of THE Scales as his hands shot out to intercept her wrists with a grip that felt like the closing of a hydraulic press!

chapters.title: Chapter 5186: Crack A Gilded One! IV
paragraphs: "Entertain me, O Gilded One!"he roared, his voice surging with a prideful fire that caused the forming suns of his domain to flare with blinding intensity.

"Show me the brilliance of the Braneworld! Show me why I should fear the children and Custodes of THE Magna Sorora...because this is an abysmal fucking introduction. Where is your pride? Where is your power? WHERE?!"
BOOM!
He twisted his body with a violent grace, pulling her inward and delivering a sharp elbow covered by Nearu Absolute Infinity that caught her beneath the chin with the force of a tectonic shift.
CRACK!

The impact wasn’t a clean hit but a brutal explosion of Nearu Absolute Infinity that sent a spray of iridescent, golden-pink blood and teeth across his obsidian-light robes, the scent of her essence being a cloying mixture of ozone and failed perfection.

Rani reeled back, her head snapping upward as the prideful strike from a "Bounded bacteria" did the impossible...it caused her actual, visceral pain that her Gilded structure couldn’t immediately ignore!

She let out a scream that was a mixture of agony and disbelief, her galaxy-filled eyes wide with the realization that the hierarchy she’d been born into was being physically dismantled by a man who shouldn’t have been able to scratch her skin!
BOOM!
She tried to retaliate by summoning THE Desidero Whisper through a spinning kick that aimed for his temple, the threads of implanted want clinging to her foot like a shroud of hungry ghosts.

Noah didn’t even bother to block the strike with his hands; he simply leaned into the impact and caught her shin with his shoulder, the weight of her wrath and her lust bouncing off his Superbius Ego without leaving a single mark on his existence.

He grabbed her leg before she could retract it and slammed his fist into the center of her thigh with a blinding slap of infinity, the sound of her muscle tearing and her Gilded femur fracturing being a heavy, textured noise that filled the silence of the void.
|Internal Damage to Custos Rani: Gilded Structure Fracture detected.|
|The target’s Luxuria Empowerment is failing to provide adequate regeneration against the weight of your Pride and Nearu Absolute Infinity.|
|The subject’s pride is beginning to leak into the surrounding space as ’Information Waste.’|
Rani scrambled back across the hardened golden floor, her pink robes now stained with her own hot, iridescent blood that pooled in configurations that looked like maps of a dying civilization.

She began to laugh madly once more, the sound being a gurgling, wet thing as she coughed up a mixture of gold fluid and grey bile, her manic eyes fixed on the man who was walking toward her with the unhurried gait of a king.
"How!? How?!"she shrieked, her voice cracking as she summoned every Pulse she had left into a final, desperate shield of golden Observable Force.
"I am a Custos of the Great Houses! I am the vessel of the Desidero! You are nothing but a mistake in the code of reality! An ant! Something Bounded!"
Noah didn’t answer her with words; he simply closed the distance in a single, terrifying step that warped the space between them into a tunnel of blue and gold fire.

He began to rain down a series of heavy, physical blows that were filled with his superior pride and backed by his infinite light, his fists and palms becoming blinding engines of destruction that smacked and hit her with a rhythmic, brutal cadence.
BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

Each strike was a wet, heavy thud that sounded like abutcher tenderizing meat, his fists crushing her ribs and his palms slamming into her face until her unfathomable beauty was nothing but a ruin of swollen flesh and shattered galaxies.

He smashed her body down onto the golden floor again and again, the surface cracking and splintering under the weight of a Gilded body being treated as nothing but a shitty, good-for-nothing rag doll.
"Is this...the modified engineering you promised for my ’worthless structure’?"
Noah asked, his voice low and dangerous as he stood over her, his hands dripping with her golden blood.
"Is this the best the high-born can do when their toys start to fight back?"

Rani lay in the center of the white sea’s ruin, her body a broken and twitching thing that was barely recognizable as the Custos who had descended from the fracture. She tried to raise her hand to manifest one final Pulse, her fingers trembling with the last remnants of her engineered Lust, but Noah didn’t give her the chance.
He raised his eyes, which were now shining with the terrifying fire of the Absolute, and he began to draw the lemniscate symbol in the air with a finger that was stained with the gold of her life.
He spoke slowly as if an ancient emperor was making his grand decree.
"Infinite Ember," he murmured, his voice sounding like the first spark of a world being born in the dark.
"First Spark of my emergence. I am the Thread. I am the Cause."
The air around Rani began to grow cold and heavy, a silence settling over the space that felt like the moment before a life is snuffed out by the turning of a tide.

"What exists without the fire of painful birth shall know that fire now. Let causality regress. Let existence remember its emergence. Let all that stands without the pained spark of life return to the moment before that spark was possible."
Noah looked down at the broken Gilded woman with a gaze that held no hatred, only a cold and pragmatic judgment that saw through the eons of her engineering.
"THE INFINITE LIGHT."
HUUM!

A blinding, multicolored radiance erupted from the symbol in the air, a light that didn’t burn or destroy but simply interrogated the history of the being it touched. It reached into Rani’s existence and asked the single question that her engineering couldn’t answer...it asked if she had suffered to become what she was, if she had climbed the long and painful path of the Bounded to earn the standing she occupied.

The Gilded architecture within her foundations screamed as the answer was recorded as a null, for she had been born into the Third Scale, engineered into her beauty, and handed her power as a birthright of The Braneworld!

The regression commenced with a clinical and terrifying precision. Rani’s broken, adult body began to shrink and smooth over, her shattered bones unbreaking as they returned to a softer, more primitive state.

Noah stood over the broken ruin of the Gilded woman, his hands stained with the shimmering, iridescent gold of her essence while the air around them vibrated with the terminal frequency of her failing pride.

He looked down at her swollen features and the galaxy-filled eyes that were now clouded with a visceral, animal terror, and for a fleeting moment, he considered the pragmatic simplicity of snuffing her out right here in the dark.

It would be easy. It would be satisfying to watch the light of a high-born doll go out permanently beneath his heel, but his tyrannical mind quickly discarded the thought because he knew the Maharanis was still connexted to her.

If Rani’s life-thread snapped, the cold Sororis would descend with the full weight of her house, and Noah wasn’t quite ready to have that particular conversation while his feet were still wet with the blood of her favorite Custos.

"I won’t kill you, little Gilded one, because your death would be far too loud for the quiet work I have planned for the Braneworld," he murmured, his voice carrying the dry, amused chill of a man who had already decided the fate of countless existences.
"But...I’m going to take the architecture of your Existence and rewrite the laws that govern it, starting with the lie of your own legitimacy."
|The subject has activated THE Infinite Light.|
|Target: Custos Rani.|
|The Pulse is interrogating the target’s causal history to identify the ’Pained Emergence’ required by THE Infinite Cause.|

The blinding radiance of the Pulse didn’t seek to regress her physical body fully, but instead dove deep into the conceptual foundations of her mind, a cold and clinical light that tore through her memories of ease and birthright.

It reached into the void where her struggles should have been and found only the engineered perfection of a being who had never climbed, and the realization hit Rani’s consciousness with the force of a psychological execution.

She let out a gurgling, wet scream as her very existence began to question its own right to occupy space, the foundational lie of her Gilded standing unraveling as she realized she had no legitimate origin to anchor her against the storm.

Her mind fractured under the weight of the interrogation, the engineered Lust that had sustained her for eons collapsing into a black hole of existential doubt that left her wide open for the next stage of Noah’s work!

Noah didn’t hesitate, for he immediately began to pour his own Quintessence Infiniforce into the cracks of her psyche, shoving the raw power of his Infinite Cause into the spaces where her autonomy used to reside.
He inserted his Infinity into her weavings like a virus, his golden light binding itself to her neural pathways until every thought she had was filtered through the lens of his own sovereign will.
It was a total and absolute consumption of her personhood, a mastery that didn’t just break her body but claimed the very concept of her self as his property.
HUUM!

Rani’s body arched off the golden floor, her back snapping with a loud and textured crack as his Infinity fused with her marrow and her spirit, and then she fell back into the white sea with a dull thud.
The galaxy-filled light in her eyes flickered and then returned, but it was no longer the manic light of a Gilded predator; it was a cold, blue-gold reflection of the man standing over her.

She lay there for a moment while the transitional domain stabilized around them, the crimson-pink clouds turning a darker, more submissive shade of violet as the anchor of the space shifted its loyalty.

Then, with a slow and mechanical grace, the Custos rose from the ruin of her own defeat and knelt at Noah’s feet, her feet touching the cold, golden floor in a gesture of total and absolute surrender.
"Master," she whispered, her voice no longer cold or seductive but hollowed out and filled with the resonance of his own pride.
"I...am the Thread. I am the Cause. Your will is the only light I acknowledge."
Noah looked down at her and felt a dark, pragmatic satisfaction, for he now had a Gilded puppet as his eyes and ears without alerting the Maharanis to the change.
He reached out and placed his hand on the top of her head, his fingers stained with the gold of her recent trauma, and he offered a brilliant, tyrannical smile to the empty void.
"Good. Because...there is so much to be done. So...so much!"
BOOM!
