She began to laugh madly once more, the sound being a gurgling, wet thing as she coughed up a mixture of gold fluid and grey bile, her manic eyes fixed on the man who was walking toward her with the unhurried gait of a king.
"How!?
How?!"she shrieked, her voice cracking as she summoned every Pulse she had left into a final, desperate shield of golden Observable Force.
"I am a Custos of the Great Houses!
I am the vessel of the Desidero!
You are nothing but a mistake in the code of reality!
An ant!
Something Bounded!"
Noah didn’t answer her with words; he simply closed the distance in a single, terrifying step that warped the space between them into a tunnel of blue and gold fire.

He began to rain down a series of heavy, physical blows that were filled with his superior pride and backed by his infinite light, his fists and palms becoming blinding engines of destruction that smacked and hit her with a rhythmic, brutal cadence.
BOOM!
BOOM!
BOOM!

Each strike was a wet, heavy thud that sounded like abutcher tenderizing meat, his fists crushing her ribs and his palms slamming into her face until her unfathomable beauty was nothing but a ruin of swollen flesh and shattered galaxies.

He smashed her body down onto the golden floor again and again, the surface cracking and splintering under the weight of a Gilded body being treated as nothing but a shitty, good-for-nothing rag doll.
"Is this...the modified engineering you promised for my ’worthless structure’?"
Noah asked, his voice low and dangerous as he stood over her, his hands dripping with her golden blood.
"Is this the best the high-born can do when their toys start to fight back?"
Rani lay in the center of the white sea’s ruin, her body a broken and twitching thing that was barely recognizable as the Custos who had descended from the fracture.
She tried to raise her hand to manifest one final Pulse, her fingers trembling with the last remnants of her engineered Lust, but Noah didn’t give her the chance.
He raised his eyes, which were now shining with the terrifying fire of the Absolute, and he began to draw the lemniscate symbol in the air with a finger that was stained with the gold of her life.
He spoke slowly as if an ancient emperor was making his grand decree.
"Infinite Ember," he murmured, his voice sounding like the first spark of a world being born in the dark.
"First Spark of my emergence.
I am the Thread.
I am the Cause."
The air around Rani began to grow cold and heavy, a silence settling over the space that felt like the moment before a life is snuffed out by the turning of a tide.
"What exists without the fire of painful birth shall know that fire now.
Let causality regress.
Let existence remember its emergence.
Let all that stands without the pained spark of life return to the moment before that spark was possible."
Noah looked down at the broken Gilded woman with a gaze that held no hatred, only a cold and pragmatic judgment that saw through the eons of her engineering.
"THE INFINITE LIGHT."
HUUM!
A blinding, multicolored radiance erupted from the symbol in the air, a light that didn’t burn or destroy but simply interrogated the history of the being it touched.

It reached into Rani’s existence and asked the single question that her engineering couldn’t answer...it asked if she had suffered to become what she was, if she had climbed the long and painful path of the Bounded to earn the standing she occupied.

The Gilded architecture within her foundations screamed as the answer was recorded as a null, for she had been born into the Third Scale, engineered into her beauty, and handed her power as a birthright of The Braneworld!
The regression commenced with a clinical and terrifying precision.
Rani’s broken, adult body began to shrink and smooth over, her shattered bones unbreaking as they returned to a softer, more primitive state.

Noah stood over the broken ruin of the Gilded woman, his hands stained with the shimmering, iridescent gold of her essence while the air around them vibrated with the terminal frequency of her failing pride.

He looked down at her swollen features and the galaxy-filled eyes that were now clouded with a visceral, animal terror, and for a fleeting moment, he considered the pragmatic simplicity of snuffing her out right here in the dark.
It would be easy.

It would be satisfying to watch the light of a high-born doll go out permanently beneath his heel, but his tyrannical mind quickly discarded the thought because he knew the Maharanis was still connexted to her.

If Rani’s life-thread snapped, the cold Sororis would descend with the full weight of her house, and Noah wasn’t quite ready to have that particular conversation while his feet were still wet with the blood of her favorite Custos.

"I won’t kill you, little Gilded one, because your death would be far too loud for the quiet work I have planned for the Braneworld," he murmured, his voice carrying the dry, amused chill of a man who had already decided the fate of countless existences.
"But...I’m going to take the architecture of your Existence and rewrite the laws that govern it, starting with the lie of your own legitimacy."
|The subject has activated THE Infinite Light.|
|Target: Custos Rani.|
|The Pulse is interrogating the target’s causal history to identify the ’Pained Emergence’ required by THE Infinite Cause.|

The blinding radiance of the Pulse didn’t seek to regress her physical body fully, but instead dove deep into the conceptual foundations of her mind, a cold and clinical light that tore through her memories of ease and birthright.

It reached into the void where her struggles should have been and found only the engineered perfection of a being who had never climbed, and the realization hit Rani’s consciousness with the force of a psychological execution.

She let out a gurgling, wet scream as her very existence began to question its own right to occupy space, the foundational lie of her Gilded standing unraveling as she realized she had no legitimate origin to anchor her against the storm.

Her mind fractured under the weight of the interrogation, the engineered Lust that had sustained her for eons collapsing into a black hole of existential doubt that left her wide open for the next stage of Noah’s work!

Noah didn’t hesitate, for he immediately began to pour his own Quintessence Infiniforce into the cracks of her psyche, shoving the raw power of his Infinite Cause into the spaces where her autonomy used to reside.
He inserted his Infinity into her weavings like a virus, his golden light binding itself to her neural pathways until every thought she had was filtered through the lens of his own sovereign will.
It was a total and absolute consumption of her personhood, a mastery that didn’t just break her body but claimed the very concept of her self as his property.
HUUM!

Rani’s body arched off the golden floor, her back snapping with a loud and textured crack as his Infinity fused with her marrow and her spirit, and then she fell back into the white sea with a dull thud.
The galaxy-filled light in her eyes flickered and then returned, but it was no longer the manic light of a Gilded predator; it was a cold, blue-gold reflection of the man standing over her.

She lay there for a moment while the transitional domain stabilized around them, the crimson-pink clouds turning a darker, more submissive shade of violet as the anchor of the space shifted its loyalty.

Then, with a slow and mechanical grace, the Custos rose from the ruin of her own defeat and knelt at Noah’s feet, her feet touching the cold, golden floor in a gesture of total and absolute surrender.
"Master," she whispered, her voice no longer cold or seductive but hollowed out and filled with the resonance of his own pride.
"I...am the Thread.
I am the Cause.
Your will is the only light I acknowledge."
Noah looked down at her and felt a dark, pragmatic satisfaction, for he now had a Gilded puppet as his eyes and ears without alerting the Maharanis to the change.
He reached out and placed his hand on the top of her head, his fingers stained with the gold of her recent trauma, and he offered a brilliant, tyrannical smile to the empty void.
"Good.
Because...there is so much to be done.
So...so much!"
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 5187: Life and Existence!
paragraphs: <Notes on Life and Existence, from The Musings of THE Genesis Monarch>

The fundamental architecture of life is built upon a foundation of absolute, unblinking inequity, for existence has never been a merchant of fairness but a butcher that decides which cuts of meat are destined for the high table and which are to be ground into the dirt of the lower domains.

Many wonder at the origins of The Gilded and The Bounded as if there were some grand, poetic reason for the disparity, yet the truth is as cold and pragmatic as a surgical strike: talent and potential are not gifts bestowed by anything, but are the raw biological and existential spoils of a theft that occurred before the first breath of a new reality was ever drawn.

It is a nauseating reality to consider that while one soul is born without a single drop of mana to lubricate the gears of their survival, another is born with the engineered capacity to extinguish stars or erase entire Primordial Realms with a casual wave of a hand, and this difference is not a matter of destiny but of structural positioning within the feeding chain of Existence.

When THE First Cause erupts to birth a new Observable Existence, it is less a celebratory event of creation and more a violent hemorrhage of raw potential that draws the attention of THE Primeval Ones who have waited in the dark for eons.

These ancient entities and their Gilded progeny do not descend upon a newly born Observable to offer blessings or guidance, but instead they latch onto the wellspring of THE First Cause like parasites at the throat of a fresh kill, drinking deep of the untapped authority to produce even more Gilded Ones and secure their own sovereign stations.

They occupy these new realms and claim the vast percentage of THE First Cause’s power for their own, leaving behind only the dredges and the thinning remnants of mana for the Bounded lifeforms who are forced to build civilizations out of the scraps that the masters found too bitter to swallow.

The smell of this existential theft permeates the very fabric of the lower domains, a tang of authority dissolving that reminds every Bounded creature that their poverty of power was a choice made by those who sit comfortably above.

The most persistent question that plagues others of the abyss is why the truly powerful, those Gilded Ones who have lived for eons and mastered the weavings of reality, would choose to anchor their immortality in the so-calledNegative Egos of Existence.
Why would a civilization capable of absolute perfection choose to amplify the filth of Pride, the searing fire of Wrath, or the bottomless, industrial hunger of Gluttony?

They did not make this choice out of a lack of imagination or a misunderstanding of morality, but because the negative Egos possess a specific gravity and a savage density that the virtues simply cannot approximate.

In an Existence where power is literal consumption and every victory is a pyrrhic struggle against the void, a soul anchored in Humility is a soul that is too light to withstand the crushing pressure of sovereign expansion, for the virtues are diffuse and yielding while the "sins" are the iron pillars upon which a truly tyrannical hierarchy can be built...or so many believe.
But they...have not played with Virtues enough to understand. They truly do not understand.
But, continuing on with the mindset that Sins are supreme.
Superbius...is a structural integrity that refuses to be altered by external force. Ira is not merely rage; it is an unyielding engine of martial readiness that ensures the sword never dulls.
Gula is not merely hunger, it is the Relentless industrial output required to process the raw meat of existence into the refined artifacts of a glorious caste.

The Gilded built their world on these foundations because anything less would have been crushed by the weight of their own stolen potential,and they found that the taste of Wrath was a more reliable fuel than the sweet, fleeting breath of Charity.

Existence continues to churn and move in a cycle of consumption and indifference, offering many questions to those who have the leisure to ask them, but the answers do not drift through the air like spores.

The truth is buried in the marrow of those who were strong enough to take it, and it reveals itself only to those who are willing to go searching in the dark places where the blood of the Bounded still stains the golden floors of the elite.
-Observations on THE Scales, THE Genesis Monarch
<THE Creature>
Many beings believed in good and evil, right and wrong, but more often than not, things were much more complex than this.

Around the same time that THE Genesis Monarch bound THE Custos of Sororis Prima Prabhavati within the transitional pink clouds of THE Desidero Domain, a far more savage drama was unfolding a vast distance away in the endlessly tumultuous regions known as THE Undefined Gaps.

These were the infinite, lightless fractures in space that existed between THE Observable Existence and THE Braneworld Observable Existence, stretching boundless and terrifying due to their sheer Undefinition.
They were almost as chaotic as the void outside of reality where no THE Second Scale entities could hope to survive for more than a heartbeat.

Within this sensory-deprivation tank of violent energy, a hunt had been carried out across the hours that passed, as a pack of THE Gilded Ones relentlessly chased after THE Young Relictus whose very presence was a stain upon their orderly masterpiece. A unique development had finally occurred within THE Undefined Gaps, for it seemed that THE Young Relictus had finally been cornered against the wall of a static, unobservable fold!

THE Creature stood at the center of the darkness, his body burning with multicolored flames that were tinted by a glorious and heavy obsidian light, his eyes reflecting the cold hunger of THE Primordial Source as he found himself surrounded by eighteen of THE Gilded Ones.

Eight of these hunters were THE Superbius Gilded Ones who floated with a nauseating degree of arrogance, their golden robes shimmering even in the lightless Gaps, while ten THE Ira Gilded Ones stood at the forefront like crimson-clad bastions of distilled rage.

The space they occupied was a textured void, a place where the darkness felt like a physical weight pressing against the skin and the only illumination came from the predatory glow of Gilded authority.

A dominating Superbius Gilded One with a grand, muscular physique floated ahead of his peers, the power of multiple Causes bouncing off his chest like rain off a mountain as he looked at THE Relictus with a gaze that held only clinical disdain.

"You truly thought you could kill one of us and simply run into the dark while growing stronger, as if THE Magna Sorora would not eventually close the loop on your transgression?"he asked, his voice carrying the resonance of an executioner’s verdict.

"When we have locked onto a thread, we don’t let it go until the information is retrieved, and momentarily even more of us will arrive here as we finally harvest and break down the components of THE Relictus."

chapters.title: Chapter 5188: Momentum!
paragraphs: At such words, THE Creature didn’t flinch or show the tremors of a cornered animal, for he only offered a brutal and unsettling smile that seemed out of place on his ancient face.

Right now, he felt a strange and piercing sense of freedom and sadness that nobody else could understand, for he was free because he was entirely alone, and because he was alone, the weight of his sadness was a physical burden that sat in his chest alongside his power.

Existence was unfair and filled with an adversity that didn’t care for the noble intentions of the weak, and he knew it was okay to feel free and sad simultaneously so long as one kept moving forward through the viscera of his own path.

He understood that existence would, by its very nature, remain exactly the way it was...a rigid hierarchy of THE Primeval Ones, THE Gilded Ones, and THE Bounded Lifeforms that would continue for countless eons of consumption unless someone moved to physically shatter the arrangement.

Nothing changed unless someone did something, and THE Creature never once entertained the delusion that he could change the entirety of existence at once, for he was far too young and the scope of the void was far too vast.
He didn’t think he could change everything, but he knew he could get started in THE Observable Existence he was currently in and move outward from there, one steady and blood-soaked step at a time.
He breathed out a slow, steady cloud of multicolored vapor and closed his eyes as he felt the resonance of the glorious source, THE Primordial Source that lived beneath the skin of reality.

All of his worries and the lingering sadness of his loneliness momentarily paused. He remembered her face as his existence became firmer and brighter as he voiced his thoughts deeply, the sound of his voice cutting through the tumultuous noise of THE Undefined Gaps.

"No, I didn’t think for a single moment that I could kill one of you and simply leave unscathed, because that was never the plan I had laid out for the afternoon. The First Domino, The False Golden Idol, was only the first domino in a much larger collapse, and I needed his death to act as a springboard to draw the rest of you out from your golden towers."
He opened his eyes, and the obsidian light within them had become a crushing, physical pressure that caused the Ira warriors to tighten their grip on their crimson blades.

"I needed multiple more of THE Gilded Ones to sustain the trajectory of my growth, which is why all of you are here now, for you’re going to help me keep my momentum during my Ascent. In existence, one needs to have momentum and pacing to keep going unceasingly, and I wasn’t running from you; I was gathering as many of you as I could while giving myself the time to prepare. Now, we can finally get started, and I suggest you remember that in Existence, there is only... Mo! Men! Tum!"
BOOM!

The entire region of THE Undefined Gaps instantly flashed with a blinding obsidian light that swallowed the golden radiance of THE Gilded Ones, all sound fading into a terrifying, unnatural silence as vision was cut off by the surge of THE Primordial Source.
The only thing that could be heard within the lightless void was the booming voice of THE Creature, sounding like the judgment of a dark titan rising from the depths of the abyss.
"Why do you all think you never got your filthy hands on THE Primordial Source?" he asked, his voice dripping with a visceral disdain.

"It’s because vile and filthy hands shouldn’t get to touch something so pristine, and while you’ll always seek it, you will never find it in the halls of your Gilded houses. It’s abhorrent that you were even able to get your hands on THE Infinite, but I believe in the future..mthat even that will be stripped from you, so today, let me show you the true face of THE Primordial Source. Let me...show you."
HUUM!
As the obsidian flames began to settle, the body of THE Creature became the only visible entity in the void, wreathed in a fire that was so dark it seemed to consume the surrounding shadows!
The obsidian flames began to coalesce and harden on his face, forming a glorious and terrifying bony mask that looked as if it had been carved from the very foundations of a dead existence.

While this bony mask formed, his aura reached levels that were so terrifying they caused the space around him to groan and crack, the smell of ancient bone and ozone filling THE Undefined Gaps as he took a single, fearless step toward the eighteen THE Gilded Ones who had thought they were the hunters.
The weight of THE Primordial Source was now absolute, and as he moved, THE Gilded Ones felt the first genuine chill of a death that they hadn’t engineered for themselves.
BOOM!
THE Gilded Ones.

His thoughts moved with the speed of a kinetic strike as he analyzed the sheer, offensive density of their power, breaking the architecture of THE Gilded Ones down into a few fundamental components that defined their absolute advantage.

Their bodies were stronger and vaster, their internal systems filled with a degree of potential that made them appear as the favored children of THE Observable Existence, especially as THE Observable Force flooded their marrow and made it nauseatingly easy for them to alter the surrounding environment through their presence alone.
With the addition of their engineered Egos, their base values were inflated to a degree that allowed them to harness their next great strength, THE Infinite.Infinity.

Within their bodies, Infinity flowed in abundance, yet THE Creature felt like he was watching something pristine being defiled by its residence in the bodies of these lifeforms, for they had not earned the right to carry the boundless.

When THE Infinite was added to their roster, it expanded their power in the reaches of THE Paleozoic Scale, allowing them to bypass the long eons of the Transitional Cambrian stage to become adults who were profoundly confident and filled with a terrifying conviction.

That was merely their starting point, but as if all of that were not enough, they had begun drawing additional power from the surrounding existences through a methodology that only those at the Proterozoic Scale could typically touch- THE Pulses of THE Scales and the raw authority of THE Causes.

chapters.title: Chapter 5189: Choices I
paragraphs: In the higher reaches of existential engineering, it was understood that while THE First Cause was the singular, erupting ocean that made way for an entire THE Observable Existence, it was comprised of countless smaller THE Causes that functioned as the currents and the laws of that reality.

THE Desidero Cause governed the mechanics of wanting and desire, while THE Superbius Cause provided the structural integrity of sovereignty, yet there were others that THE Creature could feel humming within the Gaps...THE Letum Cause, which dictated the inevitability of endings, and THE Aeternus Cause, which anchored the static configurations of existence.

These smaller THE Causes were the threads that THE Gilded Ones utilized to sew their wills into the fabric of reality, drawing upon the specific weavings of THE First Cause to bolster their own engineered foundations.

THE Creature focused his gaze on a roaring THE Superbius Gilded One whose muscular physique was a testament to the vanity of his house, seeing his body differently compared to any other being as he peered through the golden skin to witness the glistening organs and the silver-etched bones.

He saw the seas of THE Observable Force moving through the target’s vessels and identified the clusters where Infinity was anchored, tracing the shimmering threads back to THE Causes from which the Gilded warrior was currently drawing his suffocating power.
With a motion that was both beautiful and horrifying, THE Creature swung his multicolored sword, the blade wreathed in the heavy and unyielding obsidian light of THE Primordial Source.
The obsidian light acted as a terminal shears, for as the blade passed through the local space, it proceeded to sever the metaphysical connections where this Gilded One was drawing his authority!

THE Creature cut him off from THE Causes, from THE Infinite, and even from the flow of THE Observable Force, leaving the warrior with nothing but his own engineered Ego to sustain him against the darkness of THE Undefined Gaps.
SQUELCH!

The multicoloured sword passed through the chest of THE Gilded One with a wet, heavy sound of tearing meat and cracking bone, and obsidian hooks formed upon the blade to anchor its position within the target’s foundations.
As THE Creature pulled the sword out with a violent wrench, a glistening heart and several iridescent organs erupted from the chest cavity in a spray of stellar light and crimson-gold blood!

THE Creature opened his mouth and allowed his own gravitational authority to pull these organs toward him, and he proceeded to brutally chew and devour them right away, the metallic tang of Gilded essence filling his senses while the crimson-gold fluid sputtered down his chin.

The Gilded One roared out in a mixture of shock and rising rage as his heart was consumed, but before THE Creature could enjoy the taste of his victory, three other of THE Gilded Ones layered multiple THE Pulses of THE Scales upon his position from above.
BOOM!

THE Creature’s body was smashed down into the depths of the Gaps with enough force to shatter any common Ordovician Paleozoic Scale entity, and he went crashing into the solidified and inverted obsidian mountain ranges that served as the floor of the Undefinition!
BOOM!

He slowly rose from the center of a massive, smoking crater while stretching his body with a tyrannical grace, the sound of his joints popping being the only noise in the sudden silence of the impact.

He noted that THE Gilded Ones remained terrifyingly powerful, for those attacks had caused him a genuine, destabilizing pain that made his existence flicker, but he welcomed the sensation as the familiar weight of hardship and adversity.

As such vile things as THE Gilded Ones were, they were undeniably powerful, and he knew he needed to pick them off one by one, isolating them and gaining as much of their information as he could before they labeled him a greater threat and deployed genuine monsters from THE Magna Sorora.
Step by step, he would climb.

THE Creature rose up again and looked toward the heights where THE Gilded Ones were circling their gravely injured comrade, and he voiced his thoughts with a voice that was as cold as the void between the stars.
"That’s one. Are the rest of you...ready to contribute, or are you going to continue standing there while I keep my... Momentum!"
BOOM!

His body surged upward like an incandescent, flaming obsidian blade that was ready to cut open the things that should have never been cut, and the darkness of THE Undefined Gaps was once again filled with the sound of a Young Relictus beginning his ascent!

Noah was finding out something about himself that he did not expect, for the long eons of his progression had typically been defined by the spectacular and the distant, grand weavings that kept his enemies at a distance while he unmade them with a variety of weavings of power.

For the past few years, he had fought with a variety of skills and abilities and spectacular weavings of existence that were brilliant and showy and a glorious spectacle to behold, ranging from the primal fury of fireballs and the grotesque architecture of abominations to the relentless legions of the undead.

He had mastered the capabilities of Sever, Indefatigable, and the depths of the True Sources, climbing all the way through the complexities of Principles, Ways, and the heavy authority of Civilizations and Infinity itself, yet more recent fights had him finding a peculiar satisfaction... in the visceralcloseness of the struggle.

He found himself increasingly drawn to the sensation of utilizing his own hands and feeling the raw exertion of power and immensity as it translated directly into the physical collapse of his enemies, a realization that carried no trace of madness but rather a cold, pragmatic appreciation for the immediate feedback of violence.

There was an undeniable texture to bathing his hands in the very force of infinity or gripping the Spear of Civilization that held the weight of the entire Infiniverse, and feeling how the eon’s worth of advancements and the proud civilizations of his enemies shattered beneath his physical grip felt unexpectedly good!

chapters.title: Chapter 5190: Choices! II
paragraphs: The thought was an odd one to have as he paused in the silence of the transitional domain, and he asked himself whether he was developing some negative tendencies based on the Egos he was currently amplifying or if he was simply discovering a more honest method of existence.
And he had many skills, abilities, Principles that he utilized for their current stages as after he exceeded them, he didn’t use them much as he didn’t feel the need to.
But his hands and feet...he would always have his his hands and feet to smash things!

There was a profound and logical catharsis that emerged from physical combat that detached skills and grand weavings could never replicate, for skills was essentially a manipulation of the code of reality while a physical strike was a direct confrontation of essence against essence.

When one utilizes their hands and legs to break an enemy, there is no filter of interpretation and no distance of causality; there is only the wet sound of resistance and the grinding vibration of bone meeting authority that provides an absolute confirmation of one’s own superiority.
Frankly, it just felt good! He was not developing any negative tendancies or anything like that.

In the weavings of existence where every victory was bought with the blood of the Bounded, Noah found that putting the terrifying weight of his Cause and the density of his Infinity into his fists allowed him to experience the brutality of his enemies as a tangible substance that he could physically dismantle and crush into the dirt.

As he remained lost in these thoughts, he stood over the body of Custos Rani in the space she had enacted, her figure floating flat on her back with her skin and muscles pulled back in a clinical, surgical display that revealed the glowing pink-gold light of her internal components!

He observed the Gilded bones and the iridescent organs in detail, watching how the gold and silver-etched marrow and the pulsing vessels of the Luxuria designation operated with a structural complexity that surpassed anything he had seen in the lower domains.

His hands moved to analyze the makeup of her existence with the detached focus of an architect examining the blueprints of a rival’s fortress, and he nodded shortly after as he recognized the similarities between her anatomy and the components he had seen from the gift of THE Creature.

"About the same as the components I saw from the gift of THE Creature, though the resonance of the Luxuria heart is a touch more... frenetic," he said calmly, his voice vibrating with the cold authority of his Absolute Superbius Ego.
"Alright, close up, Little Rani."

As he issued the command, he closed his eyes to check on his Hadean Organ of Civilization, projecting his consciousness into the lightless and immense reaches of THE Absolute Forge of Infinity where he kept his Nearu Absolute Infinity compressed.

Within this internal workshop, he observed the fourteen massive illusory versions of himself that stood like silent sentinels of his potential, noting that while Superbius and Humilitas were already brightly lit, a third manifestation was now beginning to ignite with a shimmering, iridescent pink-gold flame.
Beside THE Absolute Amaranthine Heart of Emotive, the woman herself was moving with a manic curiosity, her eyes wide as she watched the new Ego stabilize and solidify within the forge’s architecture.

Noah appeared in front of the massive manifestation of THE Absolute Luxuria Ego of Infinity, and he looked upon the figure with an appreciative, tyrannical eye, for it was a being of shifting, crystalline skin and flowing robes of liquid starlight that seemed to pull at the very fabric of the surrounding space.

The manifestation carried a beauty that was both breathtaking and horrifying, its features possessing a predatory grace that suggested a hunger that could never be satiated regardless of how much of reality it consumed.

As he established the connection, comprehensive prompts began to bloom within his awareness, detailing the terrifying capabilities of the third completed Ego with a clinical precision that made his eyes shine with a brilliant, dark light.
|THE Absolute Luxuria Ego of Infinity has been successfully integrated into THE Absolute Forge.|

|Desire Consumption:You possess the capability to consume the desires of those around you, converting their wants and their longings into your own internal capacity for power. Every flicker of lust, ambition, and craving within your proximity flows into you as a tangible substance, allowing you to grow stronger the more your enemies desire their own survival or their own goals.|

|The Pleasure Cascade: You can induce waves of ecstatic pleasure in your targets, overwhelming their processing capacity with a sensory intensity that exceeds the structural limits of their civilization. Affected beings collapse into helpless states of total surrender, and prolonged exposure ensures the dissolution of their foundations as their existences cannot maintain coherence under the weight of continuous, engineered pleasure.|

|Quintessential Indulgence: Those without a sufficiently dense Ego find themselves unable to resist the beck and call of your presence, for your very existence broadcasts a passive radiation that makes them want nothing more than your approval. When focused, this ability pits the full will of the target against your own, forcing them to find fulfillment only in the service of your desires.|

|Pillow Talk: The very weavings of existence crave your satisfaction above all else, causing secrets, knowledge, and forbidden information to naturally flow toward you as if Existence itself were confessing its truths. Information that aligns with your current objectives will stream into your awareness without the need for active interrogation, for reality itself wants you to be satisfied.|

|THE Desidero Singularity:You can collapse the intent and the direction of all external attacks into a singular point within your own existence, transforming the ’want’ to harm you into the ’want’ to fuel you. Any strike backed by the desire for your destruction is drawn into this singularity and neutralized, its energy being added to your reserves as a tribute to your Absolute standing.|

|THE Apotheosis of the Wanton: You can rewrite the local laws of causality based entirely on your own whims and wants, making your desire the primary axiom of the region. If you want a target to unmake themselves, the very rules of their biology will begin to align with that desire, forcing their existence to struggle against its own foundational instinct for survival in favor of satisfying your whim.|
Noah’s eyes shone with a terrifying brilliance as he looked at the capabilities of Luxuria.
"Why...are there so many?" he murmured to the void of the forge, his voice carrying a dry, pragmatic amusement that echoed off the iridescent walls.
Because he was just thinking about how less abilities and skills were better for him, and yet even more unfurled!
The one positive was multiple of them being passive if he took on the transformation of Luxuria!

chapters.title: Chapter 5191: Choices! III
paragraphs: Noah was getting familiar with the capabilities of THE Absolute Luxuria Ego of Infinity, for he wanted to see exactly how its effect would manifest when projected through the lens of his own Hadean foundations.
He closed his eyes and allowed the cold integrity of his Superbius Pride to recede, beckoning the iridescent and predatory resonance of Luxuria to rise and overwrite the architecture of his form!

The transformation was not a subtle shift but a violent re-shaping of his existence, his skin becoming a shifting, crystalline substance that caught the light of the transitional domain and refracted it into a thousand sharp and hungry hues.

His robes dissolved into a flowing garment of liquid starlight that seemed to pull at the very fabric of the surrounding space, and his features settled into a beauty that was so unfathomable and dangerous it felt like a silent scream of aesthetic perfection.
Noah raised his hands to look at the shimmering, translucent texture of his crystalline fingers, his gaze moving across the predatory grace of his own limbs with a dry and pragmatic appreciation.

Beside him, the figure of Custos Rani began to tremble with a visceral intensity that shook the pink-gold radiance of her robes, her eyes wide with a shock that bordered on terror as she looked at him!

After a heartbeat of frozen incredulity, this Gilded One actually felt a dark and uncontrollable blush creep across her ruined features, and she looked down at the golden floor as if the mere sight of him was a sensory overload she could no longer sustain!
Noah was about to ask her for the specific reason of her shock when in the next moment, a sudden and catastrophic change erupted within the domain.
BOOM!

An influx of THE Observable Force and Quintessence Infiniforce erupted from his body and from the very surroundings with intensity, his existence visibly emanating an increasingly denser sense of pressure and power that threatened to crack the boundaries of the transitional space!

Noah was genuinely surprised as he sensed his generation of Quintessence Infiniforce seemingly multiplied by many times over, his body becoming encased in a thick shell of Nearu Absolute Infinity while his Pillar of Infinity also became denser and grander as more and more infinity surged into its depths!
The reason for this erupting and increasingly grand change was revealed to him in an instant as prompts began to bloom before his eyes, detailing the silent and hungry mechanics of his newest Ego.
|The passive effects of Desire Consumption have been activated.|
|The nearby subject, Custos Rani, has had her desires and emotions consumed to provide minimal gains for your weavings of existence.|

|The subject THE Living Emotive, whose heart you carry, seems to be uniquely anamolous and holds seemingly endless desires and emotions, and she has had her weavings and desires consumed as they have provided and are continuing to provide Quintessential gains for your weavings of existence.|
|Boundless desires and emotions are continuing to be absorbed and consumed from the surrounding substrate, further amplifying THE Absolute Luxuria Ego of Infinity as you move.|

Noah blinked at the prompts that bloomed before his eyes and couldn’t help but turn his gaze inward to his own Forge of Infinity, wondering exactly what kind of manic feast Emotive was providing for him.

Within the internal reaches of his consciousness, he had taken on the shimmering form of the Luxuria Ego, and he found himself looking at a startled Emotive who was staring back at him with vibrant eyes that held the manic obsession of a being who had just found her prime specimen!

She looked at him with an intensity that seemed to vibrate through the entire forge, her hands twitching as if she were trying to decide whether to run toward him or simply dissolve into a pool of satisfied starlight.
She cleared her throat and spoke in a serious fashion, yet her words came out with an absent-minded honesty that suggested she didn’t entirely mean to say them out loud.
"I...would gladly give every other part of my existence if you would just take those thick, strong arms of yours and wrap them around me and just... err."
She cleared her throat again and blinked rapidly as if she had just noticed that Noah was staring directly into her thoughts, and she quickly tried to pivot back!

"Ahem, Sir, since you are...currently present here, I wanted to use this as a chance to get your permission for something I had planned to do on my own, for my dream will never be achieved if I simply and passively remain around you without taking the initiative."
Her figure brightened.

"I have sensed THE Gilded Ones permeating and beginning to establish bases within our Observable Existence, and I had planned to begin siphoning off their emotions and egos while utilizing the immense power contained within this forge to penetrate their defenses. If I take on the form of Luxuria myself while doing so, I could bring them under my control and feed your growth with the raw meat of their own engineered wants... huhuhu... hahaha!"
Emotive put her hand on her face as she laughed devilishly, her manic joy filling the silent spaces of the forge with a resonance that was both unsettling and impressive.
Noah looked at her and thought of the initiative and the ridiculous weavings of this woman who might just be one of the more unique existences within their Observable Existence.
"Do what you need to do without getting caught. I...will only save you once or twice if you get yourself into genuine trouble."

Emotive’s eyes went wide and round as she heard these words, and she let out a soft, delighted squeal before burying her face in her hands and wiggling her feet with overwhelming joy that seemed entirely out of place.
Noah shook his head at this.
After this, Noah opened his eyes again within the transitional domain to find Custos Rani already down on her knees.
His eyes flashed coldly with the iridescent light of Luxuria, and his voice carried a heavy, demanding resonance as he addressed his puppet.
"Why do you seem so shocked at my form, and why does your Gilded existence tremble as if it has seen its own ending within my reflection?"
Rani’s pupils trembled as she slowly raised her head, her voice shaking with a reverence that she could no longer suppress beneath the weight of his radiation.

"Your figure... your presence... it reminds me of the records of Servius Desideratum, THE Devouring Vessel, who was a Luxuria to turn his desire inward and consume the very existence he was meant to serve. He is and was a terrifying and renowned figure in THE Braneworld Observable Existence during The Fourth and Fifth Ages, a being whose amplified Lust became a devouring field that could consume the emotions of THE Superbius and Ira and even the indifference of THE Relictus itself. We were taught to fear his name, and as I look at you now...the unique immensity you give seems to be close to his brilliance of Luxuria!"
WAA!
Noah listened to her explanation with a calm silence, his gaze moving across the shimmering horizon of the transitional domain!

She looked at him with an intensity that seemed to vibrate through the entire forge, her hands twitching as if she were trying to decide whether to run toward him or simply dissolve into a pool of satisfied starlight.
She cleared her throat and spoke in a serious fashion, yet her words came out with an absent-minded honesty that suggested she didn’t entirely mean to say them out loud.
"I...would gladly give every other part of my existence if you would just take those thick, strong arms of yours and wrap them around me and just... err."
She cleared her throat again and blinked rapidly as if she had just noticed that Noah was staring directly into her thoughts, and she quickly tried to pivot back!

"Ahem, Sir, since you are...currently present here, I wanted to use this as a chance to get your permission for something I had planned to do on my own, for my dream will never be achieved if I simply and passively remain around you without taking the initiative."
Her figure brightened.

"I have sensed THE Gilded Ones permeating and beginning to establish bases within our Observable Existence, and I had planned to begin siphoning off their emotions and egos while utilizing the immense power contained within this forge to penetrate their defenses.
If I take on the form of Luxuria myself while doing so, I could bring them under my control and feed your growth with the raw meat of their own engineered wants... huhuhu... hahaha!"
Emotive put her hand on her face as she laughed devilishly, her manic joy filling the silent spaces of the forge with a resonance that was both unsettling and impressive.
Noah looked at her and thought of the initiative and the ridiculous weavings of this woman who might just be one of the more unique existences within their Observable Existence.
"Do what you need to do without getting caught.
I...will only save you once or twice if you get yourself into genuine trouble."

Emotive’s eyes went wide and round as she heard these words, and she let out a soft, delighted squeal before burying her face in her hands and wiggling her feet with overwhelming joy that seemed entirely out of place.
Noah shook his head at this.
After this, Noah opened his eyes again within the transitional domain to find Custos Rani already down on her knees.
His eyes flashed coldly with the iridescent light of Luxuria, and his voice carried a heavy, demanding resonance as he addressed his puppet.
"Why do you seem so shocked at my form, and why does your Gilded existence tremble as if it has seen its own ending within my reflection?"
Rani’s pupils trembled as she slowly raised her head, her voice shaking with a reverence that she could no longer suppress beneath the weight of his radiation.

"Your figure... your presence... it reminds me of the records of Servius Desideratum, THE Devouring Vessel, who was a Luxuria to turn his desire inward and consume the very existence he was meant to serve.

He is and was a terrifying and renowned figure in THE Braneworld Observable Existence during The Fourth and Fifth Ages, a being whose amplified Lust became a devouring field that could consume the emotions of THE Superbius and Ira and even the indifference of THE Relictus itself.
We were taught to fear his name, and as I look at you now...the unique immensity you give seems to be close to his brilliance of Luxuria!"
WAA!
Noah listened to her explanation with a calm silence, his gaze moving across the shimmering horizon of the transitional domain!

chapters.title: Chapter 5192: Choices! IV
paragraphs: After receiving knowledge of some renowned Gilded One and the mention of Ages from Custos Rani, Noah had commanded this puppet gently for her to transfer all the knowledge she had to him, his fingers lingering on her forehead as the iridescent weavings of her memory began to bleed into his own consciousness.

He wanted these memories because at this moment, he wanted to have a clear definition of his long-term and short-term goals, for he found that navigating the higher domains without a definitive map was a tedious waste of his infinite potential.

His end goal was simply safety and an existence where he didn’t have to worry about the encroaching shadows of the void, envisioning a quiet life of mana and farming that felt more like a distant dream than a reachable reality.
But dumb fuckers would not leave him alone and continued to press their engineered arrogance against his skin, so they made his goal a bit more complex than the simple cultivation of a garden.
To achieve his very straightforward goal, he had to overcome the gap between Bounded and Gilded, ensuring his safety against Gilded monsters and those above them who could stand in his way.
He really thought he had been mild and laid-back for the most part since he came out of his Wheel of Existence and entered the Folds, acting with a restraint...well, for the most part.
He hadn’t really done anything too crazy!
But when he thought about THE Gilded Ones and what he could do to overcome them and eliminate the threat of these beings and their immense weavings of existence...
He looked at the kneeling form of Rani and then toward the distant coming horizons of THE Braneworld Observable Existence with a gaze that turned unfathomably cold.
"Is it time to return on the brutal path of conquest again?"
BOOM!

Existence around him began to buzz as if his surroundings were becoming shaky at this thought, for the very idea of Noah returning to his path of absolute expansion sent ripples through the weavings of the transitional domain!

There was Ubergulden Adelheid who had an apparent unique and high identity among THE Superbius, and he already had a Luxuria Gilded One under his control as if he truly exerted himself and returned to his path of Conquest...
He could begin silently moving in the shadows to bring to his control more and more of THE Gilded Ones before he began to wage open war on a glorious path of Conquest and Quintessence.

And as he received the memories from Custos Rani, his eyes clouded over with the weight of eons of Gilded history and the staggering geography of the higher domains, as well as history of countless unsavory things.

He was disgusted and amazed at the complexities of the power structures and lands of THE Braneworld Observable Existence that Rani had information of as they were heavy and filled with many things that would require his immediate attention.

As he processed the memories more and more, his short-term goals of conquest and Ubergulden Adelheid and his end goal of farming with boundless infinity and mana gained a rigid structure as he nodded to the empty air.

"Conquer THE Gilded Ones, exceed Vakochev’s Scales by designing my Infinite Scales to be even grander, refine my THE Infinite Cause, and gain access to THE Primordial Source... light work. Light fucking work!"
<THE Creature>

THE Creature continued his desperate and calculated dance within the lightless folds of THE Undefined Gaps, his multicolored flames flickering with a violent intensity as he fended off the collective assault of THE Gilded Ones.

Multiple other Ira Gilded Ones were already heavily injured and leaking iridescent ichor into the void, yet they continued to look at him with a cold and engineered hatred that required no words to convey!

THE Creature calculated exactly how much time he had left before the weight of his actions drew a response he couldn’t survive, for he knew he needed to wrap things up and return to the shadows of THE Undefinition.
He had gained a fleeting glimpse of knowledge regarding the terrifying scope of their power, and he knew that these beings weren’t merely lifeforms contained within a single pocket of Existence.

There were extremely old and ancient Gilded Ones who had been present even before he was born, entities who were able to harness the raw power of THE First Cause to propagate even more Gilded Ones for the future across the eons.
Such beings and those within THE Magna Sorora held power and complexities that allowed their influence to span across multiple Observable Existences, no only a single one!
Whether they were called THE Braneworld Observable Existence or whatever unique names they established for the territories they occupied.
He had to wrap things up here and move, yet before his intent could translate into a single step of retreat...
BOOM!

A terrifying impact boomed out across the entire region of THE Undefined Gaps, sending the very fabric of existence spinning in a nauseating blur before THE Creature was smashed onto a solidified obsidian floor of THE Undefinition.

For the first time since his emergence, he gazed coldly at his own left hand which he had raised instinctively in a desperate defense, seeing that the long bone covered by the obsidian flames of THE Primordial Source was visibly fractured.

A crimson scorch mark marred his skin as if he had been burnt by a fire comprised of dense Infinity and Observable Force, and tremendous waves of pain cascaded through his existence with a texture that demanded his absolute acknowledgment!

He rose from the center of the crater with his gaze remaining as cold and unyielding as the obsidian mountain ranges around him, looking up to see that the domain he had enacted to remain hidden had been pierced by a force of absolute authority.
New entrants...had arrived.

A terrifyingly radiant woman floated above the wreckage of his concealment, a crimson gold crown hanging diagonally upon her head as her imperious gaze looked down upon him with a total absence of warmth.
It was actually the entity standing beside her who had smashed into THE Creature and caused such a grievous injury, and THE Creature’s eyes narrowed as he analyzed the threat before him.

The entity was a terrifyingly muscular giant who shone with the concentrated crimson light of THE Ira, his massive arms and legs wrapped in crimson halos that radiated a power so heavy it caused the surrounding space to groan!

chapters.title: Chapter 5193: End of The Road! I
paragraphs: He possessed an extremely brutal and devilish smile that showed too many teeth, and he looked down at THE Creature as if he were observing a particularly interesting insect that he was about to crush.
"Is this the anomaly that has arisen from the lands below that you all are allowing to run so rampantly?"the massive entity asked, his voice sounding like the grinding of tectonic plates.

"He doesn’t seem like much of anything at all, especially considering I’ve felt genuine fear from actual monstrous Relictus before, so tell me, is this one merely a chickling that has wandered too far from its nest?"
This Ira turned his predatory gaze toward the woman beside him, his crimson halos pulsing with readiness that was almost suffocating to perceive!
"Ubergulden Hye-jin, do I have your permission to let loose and see what his bones are made of?"

The imperious and regal gaze of the woman with a loose diagonal crown, Ubergulden Hye-jin, remained fixed on THE Creature, her voice ringing out through THE Undefined Gaps with the cold precision of a royal decree!
"Don’t destroy his body completely, Prima Custos Ragnar, for we need to extract and harvest what we can of THE Primordial Source once his resistance has been properly neutralized.

THE Creature’s gaze remained cold the entire time as he affirmed heavily that actual powerhouses of THE Gilded Ones had appeared to conclude the hunt. Gauging how he had been injured so severely from the very first strike, he knew that his next move had to be absolute, but-
BOOM!
Before his thoughts could even solidify into action, his body moved instinctively as he used his reforming hand and his uninjured hand to block the descent of a mountain!
Prima Custos Ragnar had already appeared above him with a speed that even he could barely perceive, his massive fist being larger than THE Creature’s entire body as it smashed down with weight!

The impact caused the surrounding space to shatter like fragile glass before it rapidly reformed under the pressure of the attack, and obsidian light flashed incessantly around THE Creature as he warped and appeared in a different location!
His eyes were heavy and his expression had turned pale for the first time!
Ragnar’s body was reinforced with THE Observable Force in concentrations millions of times greater than any of THE Gilded Ones he had faced so far.
Before THE Creature could even attempt to counter-attack, Ragnar was already behind him, punching out with a force that seemed to ignite the very vacuum of THE Undefined Gaps.

THE Creature turned to meet the threat with a punch burning with the concentrated obsidian flames of THE Primordial Source, but the discrepancy in raw existential mass was a gap that simple conviction could not bridge at this stage of his growth!
BOOM!

The impact this time was not an explosion of shared force but a chillingly quiet display of absolute dominance as Ragnar’s massive hand simply opened and swallowed THE Creature’s fist, the crimson rings wrapping around the giant’s wrist flaring with a violent, authoritative light.

These rings immediately elongated and clamped onto THE Creature’s arm like hungry, metallic serpents, and they began to emanate a suffocating pressure drawn from multiple Causes that anchored his existence to Ragnar’s own, pinning him in place within THE Undefined Gaps!
Oh!

Ragnar did not let go of the pinned limb, and instead used his free hand to begin a systematic and terrifyingly brutal pummeling that lacked the grace of a duel and possessed all the clinical savagery of a butcher unmaking a carcass!

The first strike caught THE Creature in the solar plexus, a heavy, wet sound of collapsing muscle and shattering internal weavings echoing through the lightless void as the obsidian flames covering his torso were snuffed out by the sheer density of Infinity and THE Observable Force!
BOOOM!

Ragnar’s massive fist struck again and again with a rhythmic, sickening cadence, each blow landing with a force that shattered a dozen ribs and sent fragments of bone deep into THE Creature’s internal organs.
Tremendous waves of pain cascaded through his consciousness, the taste of blood and his own dissolving authority filling his mouth while the obsidian light in his eyes began to flicker and dim.

He tried to raise his uninjured hand to block the next strike, but the crimson rings on Ragnar’s arm emitted a sudden pulse of Infinity that pinned his remaining arm to his side, leaving his chest and face entirely vulnerable to the giant’s wrath!

Ragnar smiled with a brutal, intimate malice as he delivered a rising punch burning with Infinity that caught THE Creature beneath his obsidian-masked jaw, the force of the hit causing his head to snap back with a textured, grinding noise of a fractured spine!
SQUELCH!

The sound of the impact was followed by the spray of dark, iridescent ichor as THE Creature’s mouth was filled with the metallic fluid of his own civilization, yet Ragnar did not cease the assault, instead raining down a flurry of short, piston-like punches into THE Creature’s midsection!

Each strike was a visceral explosion of power that mutilated the flesh and shattered the foundations beneath, and THE Creature could feel his very connection to THE Primordial Source beginning to fray under the sustained, multi-Cause overload!

He was being treated like a piece of worthless scrap, his bones being ground into powder and his muscles being torn from their anchors as Ragnar laughed with the genuine, manic glee of a predator who had finally found something that didn’t die after the first few hits!

The discrepancy was far too vast, for Ragnar was reinforced with concentrations of THE Observable Force that were millions of times denser than anything THE Creature had previously encountered, making every strike feel as though the entire weight of THE Braneworld were being focused into a single, massive fist!
When Ragnar finally released the crimson rings and let the mangled limb drop, THE Creature fell away like a discarded rag, his body a twisted ruin of broken bone and flickering, dying obsidian fire.
He lay in the center of the obsidian crater as utter devastation manifested across his entire being, his skin scorched and his limbs bent at angles that no living thing should survive!

chapters.title: Chapter 5194: End of The Road! II
paragraphs: From above, the cold and clinical voice of Ubergulden Hye-jin rang out with a total absence of interest in the suffering she had just authorized.
"Contain him and shackle him, Ragnar, and don’t play around with the meat any longer."
THE Creature heard the words clearly as his entire existence was buzzing with the static of near-collapse, a sound continuing to play in his mind as if his very civilization were shaking.
His Existence was shaking from the pain and destruction as he couldn’t help but remember her.
Her face. Her warmth.
Her smile that was taken away so senselessly!
HUUM!
Anf his existence began to burn with rage!

His internal foundations were asking him if this was the end, if his climb was to be concluded as a harvest for the Superbius houses, and the massive, crimson-haloed hands of Ragnar neared him to finish the shackling!
He did not yet enact any change! He had not changed anything, so how could he be broken here?!
In that moment of absolute end, THE Creature felt his existence roaring in a desperate, primal defiance that reached deeper than his broken bones and his mutilated flesh!

He reached into the void of his own foundations for THE Primordial Source, searching through the wreckage of his consciousness until he found a single, ancient letter from THE Tongue of THE Primordial Source.

It was a letter that carried a meaning that transcended the eons and was forged in the pained emergence of the first things, and he roared it out of his existence with a volume that threatened to shatter the very foundations of THE Undefined Gaps.
"...PERSEVERE!"
BOOM!

Obsidian flames erupted from his body in an endless pillar of absolute authority, the force of the eruption actually pushing the brutally smiling Ragnar back by several meters as the space around them groaned under the weight of the ancient letter!
The giant laughed and roared out with a genuine excitement, his crimson halos spinning with a newfound intensity as he witnessed the impossible recovery.
"Oh? Now that seems like the genuine power of a Relictus! Haha, good! Rise! Tatakae! TATAKAE!"
BOOM!

The scene was shocking as THE Creature’s wounds and broken bones rapidly healed themselves under the surge of the obsidian fire, his muscles knitting back together and his spine snapping back into alignment with a series of loud, textured pops.

He rose from the crater with his obsidian mask hardening and his aura flaring with the weight of the ancient letter, looking coldly at Prima Custos Ragnar as his power seemed even grander and more terrifying than before!
HUUM!
Prima Custos Ragnar looked toward THE Young Relictus whose aura was even grander as he cracked his neck, the sound echoing like the snapping of dry branches in the cold silence of THE Undefined Gaps.
He asked with a dry, predatory amusement...
"What is the whole deal with "Persevere" anyway? It is among the words THE Relictus love to use as it does ridiculous things to the local architecture of existence, but..."
"But today, buddy boy, today is just not your day,"Ragnar said, his voice dropping into a register of cold certainty.
"You can Persevere for as long as you want, but even a mountain eventually finds itself ground into dust by the turning of the tides."
HUUM!

Ragnar’s existence pulsed with a terrifying density as he raised his hand and pulled from one of the ninePrime Causesthat comprised THE First Cause, reaching into the fundamental substrate of reality to graspTHE Dominion Cause,otherwise known as THE Cause of Supremacy.

The second experiential truth that emerged during THE First Cause was the truth that wherever multiple conscious beings exist, they will inevitably arrange themselves into configurations where some stand above others.

This arrangement is not imposed from outside but emerges from the interior of consciousness itself, derived from the recognition that differing capacities produce differing standings, and THE Dominion Cause holds this truth as its foundational axiom.
Many Armamental Axioms emerged from it.

It governed all authority, all governance, all hierarchy, all command, and all submission, for every arrangement in which one being holds power over another draws its structural legitimacy from this singular Prime Cause.

Ragnar pulled upon that Cause and allowed it to flow in his Rivers of Infinity in one hand, while his other hand reached toward a second Prime Axis to grasp THE Bellum Cause, also known as THE Cause of Conflict!
This was the Third Axis of Division: the fundamental truth that existence fights, born from the reality that consciousness encountering other consciousness inevitably produces friction.

THE Bellum Cause holds this truth as its foundational axiom, asserting that fighting is not an aberration of existence but a core function of it, as essential to the arrangement as breathing is to the body. It governed all conflict, all warfare, all violence, and all the structured expressions of one existence pressing against another with the intent to overcome, for every blade that has been swung or Pulse that has been cast draws its legitimacy from this Cause.

The power of both Prime Causes flowed in his hands, cascading across his Rivers of Infinity as he swung his hands down in a motion that sought to erase THE Young Relictus from the coordinates of THE Undefined Gaps!
HUUM!

Crimson and gold forces that the common eye couldn’t even perceive thundered down with the weight of entire civilizations, and THE Young Relictus erupted with his power, pulling from THE Primordial Source in a desperate, surging defense!

Ragnar laughed because the display was pitifully weak compared to the genuine Relictus he had feared in the eons of the past, and he watched with a cold, analytical eye as the result of the collision manifested.
BOOM!

THE Young Relictus faced a force so terrifying that when it smashed down, his entire body that had just risen was flattened again, the impact grinding him into the solidified obsidian floor of THE Undefinition.
Countless bones were broken with a sickening, wet crack, and his internal organs were ruptured into a slurry of golden ichor and obsidian fire that pooled in the crater!
Ragnar smiled with a cruelty that suggested he was finally enjoying the texture of the engagement, his crimson halos spinning with a violent light.
"Come on, say it again, buddy boy. Persevere, Persevere!"
"Persevere!"
BOOM!

Obsidian flames raged on THE Young Relictus’s body as his fractured existence and civilization healed through sheer causal defiance, and he began to rise once again, his aura flickering with a strength that was objectively grander than before!
Ragnar couldn’t help but laugh wildly before he bellowed out...
"Buddy boy, you simply don’t get the magnitude of the forces arrayed against you!"
BOOM!
The combined weight of THE Observable Force, Infinity, and two Prime Causes flowed through Ragnar as he struck out again, and THE Creature was flattened once more into the blood-stained crater!
Ragnar’s voice boomed through the void, encouraging him to rise again, to find that word and scream it against the darkness one more time!
"Go on, buddy boy, again!"
"Persevere!"
Obsidian flames raged once more as THE Creature healed and rose, his bones knitting together with the sound of grinding stone, before an instant later...
BOOM!
He was flattened again, the cycle of violence becoming a rhythmic, brutal cadence that stained the obsidian mountains with the scent of ozone and cooling blood.

THE Creature was decimated again and again, his body being ground into a ruin of meat and information as he uttered that single word of defiance every time his consciousness flickered back into focus.

By the eighty-first time, THE Creature was heaving in a crater filled with his own blood and the dissolved remnants of his authority, his breath coming in gurgling, wet gasps as Ragnar knelt toward him.
The Gilded One’s massive head came beside his ear, and he breathed in the scent of the decimation he had caused, his devilish smile inches away from THE Creature’s nearly shattered skull.

"It has been so, so boring lately, and I have been so, so lonely in the heights of the Braneworld. I can only break and collapse so many Luxuria whores..." Ragnar whispered just to him, while the other THE Gilded Ones watched from above with cold, judgmental gazes.

"I thank you for coming, as I can sense you come with change, so come on, buddy boy. Say that fucking word again, otherwise all of this will be over and we will have captured nothing but a tiny, broken little Relictus."
BOOM!

THE Creature’s existence buzzed at these words, and even throughout this carnage, his eyes never lost their light of defiance, for they burned with a fire that Ragnar’s Prime Causes couldn’t extinguish!

Ragnar picked up the head of THE Creature by the hair, and THE Creature looked at the Gilded monster through blood-clotted eyes, voicing out through broken teeth a question that carried the weight of a curse.
"Did you... forget that every time you come close to grasping THE Primordial Source... it gets taken from you?"
The words were heavy and unhurried, and Ragnar blinked as he smiled even wider, the irony of the statement not lost on his mind. And as if on cue...
BOOM!

The region above THE Undefined Gaps shattered as a baleful obsidian brilliance unfolded alongside a roar that smashed several weaker THE Gilded Ones from the skies and into the ground like falling stars.

Ubergulden Hye-jin gazed coldly above as the form of a titanic beast began to manifest in the distance, a being that was likely countless gigaparsecs away yet whose form was enlarging with a terrifying speed.
Its size alone was likely as vast as a Primordial Realm, and though it was far, it neared with a gravity that threatened to pull the entire Gap into its orbit.
Ragnar looked up toward the approaching darkness and smiled brutally, while above, Ubergulden Hye-jin took her diagonal crown off and whispered into its crimson-gold surface...
"A genuine Relictus actually came. Bring the others quickly."
BOOM!
Down below, Ragnar closed his massive fingers into the cranium of THE Creature, his grip tightening until the obsidian mask began to groan under the pressure.

"See? I knew you would make things exciting again, and I cannot thank you enough for starting this war, buddy boy. Do you want to bet if you will miraculously make it out of this alive, hmm? Wanna bet?!"
Ragnar asked these words as THE Creature only stared coldly at him, his answer being a single, final vibration of authority.
"Persevere."
BOOM!

Obsidian flames rose up higher than ever before, THE Creature breaking the grip of Ragnar as the Gilded giant laughed boisterously, and all of existence groaned for the catastrophic change that was about to unfold!

"Contain him and shackle him, Ragnar, and don’t play around with the meat any longer."
THE Creature heard the words clearly as his entire existence was buzzing with the static of near-collapse, a sound continuing to play in his mind as if his very civilization were shaking.
His Existence was shaking from the pain and destruction as he couldn’t help but remember her.
Her face.
Her warmth.
Her smile that was taken away so senselessly!
HUUM!
Anf his existence began to burn with rage!

His internal foundations were asking him if this was the end, if his climb was to be concluded as a harvest for the Superbius houses, and the massive, crimson-haloed hands of Ragnar neared him to finish the shackling!
He did not yet enact any change!
He had not changed anything, so how could he be broken here?!
In that moment of absolute end, THE Creature felt his existence roaring in a desperate, primal defiance that reached deeper than his broken bones and his mutilated flesh!

He reached into the void of his own foundations for THE Primordial Source, searching through the wreckage of his consciousness until he found a single, ancient letter from THE Tongue of THE Primordial Source.

It was a letter that carried a meaning that transcended the eons and was forged in the pained emergence of the first things, and he roared it out of his existence with a volume that threatened to shatter the very foundations of THE Undefined Gaps.
"...PERSEVERE!"
BOOM!

Obsidian flames erupted from his body in an endless pillar of absolute authority, the force of the eruption actually pushing the brutally smiling Ragnar back by several meters as the space around them groaned under the weight of the ancient letter!
The giant laughed and roared out with a genuine excitement, his crimson halos spinning with a newfound intensity as he witnessed the impossible recovery.
"Oh?
Now that seems like the genuine power of a Relictus!
Haha, good!
Rise!
Tatakae!
TATAKAE!"
BOOM!

The scene was shocking as THE Creature’s wounds and broken bones rapidly healed themselves under the surge of the obsidian fire, his muscles knitting back together and his spine snapping back into alignment with a series of loud, textured pops.

He rose from the crater with his obsidian mask hardening and his aura flaring with the weight of the ancient letter, looking coldly at Prima Custos Ragnar as his power seemed even grander and more terrifying than before!
HUUM!
Prima Custos Ragnar looked toward THE Young Relictus whose aura was even grander as he cracked his neck, the sound echoing like the snapping of dry branches in the cold silence of THE Undefined Gaps.
He asked with a dry, predatory amusement...
"What is the whole deal with "Persevere" anyway?
It is among the words THE Relictus love to use as it does ridiculous things to the local architecture of existence, but..."
"But today, buddy boy, today is just not your day,"Ragnar said, his voice dropping into a register of cold certainty.
"You can Persevere for as long as you want, but even a mountain eventually finds itself ground into dust by the turning of the tides."
HUUM!

The second experiential truth that emerged during THE First Cause was the truth that wherever multiple conscious beings exist, they will inevitably arrange themselves into configurations where some stand above others.

This arrangement is not imposed from outside but emerges from the interior of consciousness itself, derived from the recognition that differing capacities produce differing standings, and THE Dominion Cause holds this truth as its foundational axiom.
Many Armamental Axioms emerged from it.

It governed all authority, all governance, all hierarchy, all command, and all submission, for every arrangement in which one being holds power over another draws its structural legitimacy from this singular Prime Cause.

Ragnar pulled upon that Cause and allowed it to flow in his Rivers of Infinity in one hand, while his other hand reached toward a second Prime Axis to grasp THE Bellum Cause, also known as THE Cause of Conflict!
This was the Third Axis of Division: the fundamental truth that existence fights, born from the reality that consciousness encountering other consciousness inevitably produces friction.

THE Bellum Cause holds this truth as its foundational axiom, asserting that fighting is not an aberration of existence but a core function of it, as essential to the arrangement as breathing is to the body.

It governed all conflict, all warfare, all violence, and all the structured expressions of one existence pressing against another with the intent to overcome, for every blade that has been swung or Pulse that has been cast draws its legitimacy from this Cause.

The power of both Prime Causes flowed in his hands, cascading across his Rivers of Infinity as he swung his hands down in a motion that sought to erase THE Young Relictus from the coordinates of THE Undefined Gaps!
HUUM!

Crimson and gold forces that the common eye couldn’t even perceive thundered down with the weight of entire civilizations, and THE Young Relictus erupted with his power, pulling from THE Primordial Source in a desperate, surging defense!

Ragnar laughed because the display was pitifully weak compared to the genuine Relictus he had feared in the eons of the past, and he watched with a cold, analytical eye as the result of the collision manifested.
BOOM!

THE Young Relictus faced a force so terrifying that when it smashed down, his entire body that had just risen was flattened again, the impact grinding him into the solidified obsidian floor of THE Undefinition.
Countless bones were broken with a sickening, wet crack, and his internal organs were ruptured into a slurry of golden ichor and obsidian fire that pooled in the crater!

Persevere, Persevere!"
"Persevere!"
