chapters.title: Chapter 5219: Darkness! II
paragraphs: Inside her own consciousness, away from the performance of composure she was maintaining for the assembled Gilded Ones surrounding her, the wound was considerably deeper than the physical ones.

She was Sororis Prima Prabhavati of the Maharanis House, a Royal bloodline that traced its lineage backward through five ages of the Gilded hierarchy without interruption. She was a member of THE Magna Sorora, The most exclusive administrative bodies in THE Braneworld Observable Existence.

She had earned her standing through eons of power that had pushed her to the upper reaches of Ordovician Paleozoic Scale. She had faced challenges that most Gilded Ones at her tier would have called insurmountable and had found them surmountable because she was who she was.
And this thing had chased her through the Wandering Territories like she was prey.
Like she was the quarry rather than the hunter!
Like the distinction between what she was and what it was did not register as meaningful information to whatever passed for its decision-making architecture.
"Fuck!"
She flung several Silurian Light Pulses at him with the specific energy expenditure of someone who knew the Pulses would not work and was deploying them anyway.
The Pulses smashed into his scales and were ineffective.
He gazed at her coldly.
And then his eyes, those crystalline blue things burning with the quality she had identified as controlled madness, seemed to smile. Not his mouth. His eyes!
She turned to the other Sororis Primas behind her and delivered her assessment.

"What we may be looking at is a variation of a being filled with THE Gamaidjan that has undergone some form of mutation or engineering. The madness quality in its eyes is consistent with THE Gamaidjan’s effects but it is operating with too much coherence for uncontrolled infection. It did not express THE Primordial Source even once during the engagement, which eliminates the Relictus classification."

She looked at the chains holding him. "As for why it targeted me specifically, I do not know. I have no prior engagement with a being of this description. But it is contained now, and contained means we have options we did not have seconds ago."
She looked upward at the hundreds of Gilded Ones maintaining the chain configuration, their Ira foundations locked in the tension of holding something that was actively trying to be elsewhere.
Then she looked back at him.

"Will you talk?" Her voice carried the cold authority of a Sororis Prima addressing something that had temporarily been elevated to the status of prisoner, which was a significant elevation from its prior status as threat.
"Or do we have to carve out your existence to get answers? You are now bound by weavings of Superbius and Ira. Egos you cannot comprehend. It’s best you talk now, little beast."
The Gilded Ones were grand.
She believed this completely and without irony, because the evidence of the last several seconds supported it rather than contradicted it.
They had fought against Relictus for eons.
Even though this Beast of Infinity had killed one of theirs and sent two Sororis Primas scrambling through light-years of contested territory, they had contained him.
And yet.

There was a foreboding quality in the air that Prabhavati could not dismiss, a specific atmospheric weight that her Superbius foundations registered as a preliminary signal without being able to identify the source with enough precision to act on the identification.
The Beast of Infinity kept his eyes on her. The mad crystalline blue of them did not waver. Did not survey the chains or assess the surrounding Gilded Ones. Just...her.
His jaws opened.
"Pride?" The voice that came out carried the harmonic depth of a form built to project. "Wrath? Superbius? Ira?"
A sound emerged that was technically laughter and contained zero warmth. "You know nothing of true Pride. You know nothing of SUPERBIUS!"
BOOM!
Prabhavati saw it bloom from within him.

Golden Pride rose from the Beast of Infinity’s foundations and she experienced the specific vertigo of a Superbius Gilded One encountering an expression of their own foundational Ego in a configuration that exceeded what their own engineering had ever produced.

It was not the engineered Superbius of the Gilded caste system, refined across generations. It was something rawer and grander and more fundamental, as though someone had gone back to the source from which the Gilded engineering was derived and drawn directly from it rather than through the derived methodology.
It felt purer than her own.
The thought arrived and she rejected it and it returned!

The golden glow spread outward from his body and wrapped around the chains holding him, and where the glow touched chain, the chain’s resistance registered his Pride as a legitimate authority rather than a force to be opposed!

Dozens of chains came apart simultaneously, the structural integrity of their collective foundation failing not because his strength had exceeded it but because the Pride he was broadcasting had convinced the weavings that they were not in the presence of something they should be restraining.
He pulled on the remaining chains.
He took a step.
It felt like...an Infinite Step.

Prabhavati had time to register that he had closed every meter of the distance between them in no time at all before she registered anything else, and what she registered next was pressure at her chest, the specific pressure of something that had bypassed her defensive weavings completely.
His claws pierced through.
Her Heart of Civilization shattered.

The pain was absolute and immediate and total in the way that only existential damage at this particular location produced, the Heart not being merely an organ but being the anchor point of everything her Civilization was built upon, and its shattering sent fractures through every adjacent structure simultaneously.
And The Beast of Infinity...
He was smiling!
Brutally, completely!
His jaws opened wide.

She felt herself taken in, felt the jaws close around her Gilded existence with the comprehensive finality of an ending, her foundations beginning to break down under the devouring pressure of Infinity that consumed rather than coexisted.

Blood and bone registered distantly, the sensations of her Gilded physiology failing under conditions it had not been engineered to survive. The warmth of her own ichor. The grinding texture of structures that had held for eons giving way.
She.
A Sororis Prima of THE Magna Sorora.
Was dying?
She had not conceived of this outcome as a genuine possibility...ever.

Hundreds more chains erupted from the surrounding Gilded Ones, wrapping around the Beast of Infinity in overlapping configurations that exceeded the prior arrangement’s density, the collective desperation of the assembly translating into the most comprehensive restraint the assembled force could produce.
His terrible golden Pride strained against the new chains. The chains held at the edges of what holding meant.
But the darkness was already coming for Prabhavati.
Inexorable and patient!
And before he final femtoseconds, she heard...
"You shouldn’t...have tried to kill and replace me with your Custos."
BOOM!
Her consciousness wavered as she held a realization, but...it was too late!

sentences.text: Inside her own consciousness, away from the performance of composure she was maintaining for the assembled Gilded Ones surrounding her, the wound was considerably deeper than the physical ones.
She was Sororis Prima Prabhavati of the Maharanis House, a Royal bloodline that traced its lineage backward through five ages of the Gilded hierarchy without interruption.
She was a member of THE Magna Sorora, The most exclusive administrative bodies in THE Braneworld Observable Existence.
She had earned her standing through eons of power that had pushed her to the upper reaches of Ordovician Paleozoic Scale.
She had faced challenges that most Gilded Ones at her tier would have called insurmountable and had found them surmountable because she was who she was.
And this thing had chased her through the Wandering Territories like she was prey.
Like she was the quarry rather than the hunter!
Like the distinction between what she was and what it was did not register as meaningful information to whatever passed for its decision-making architecture.
"Fuck!"
She flung several Silurian Light Pulses at him with the specific energy expenditure of someone who knew the Pulses would not work and was deploying them anyway.
The Pulses smashed into his scales and were ineffective.
He gazed at her coldly.
And then his eyes, those crystalline blue things burning with the quality she had identified as controlled madness, seemed to smile.
Not his mouth.
His eyes!
She turned to the other Sororis Primas behind her and delivered her assessment.
"What we may be looking at is a variation of a being filled with THE Gamaidjan that has undergone some form of mutation or engineering.
The madness quality in its eyes is consistent with THE Gamaidjan’s effects but it is operating with too much coherence for uncontrolled infection.
It did not express THE Primordial Source even once during the engagement, which eliminates the Relictus classification."
She looked at the chains holding him.
"As for why it targeted me specifically, I do not know.
I have no prior engagement with a being of this description.
But it is contained now, and contained means we have options we did not have seconds ago."
She looked upward at the hundreds of Gilded Ones maintaining the chain configuration, their Ira foundations locked in the tension of holding something that was actively trying to be elsewhere.
Then she looked back at him.

"Will you talk?" Her voice carried the cold authority of a Sororis Prima addressing something that had temporarily been elevated to the status of prisoner, which was a significant elevation from its prior status as threat.
"Or do we have to carve out your existence to get answers?
You are now bound by weavings of Superbius and Ira.
Egos you cannot comprehend.
It’s best you talk now, little beast."
The Gilded Ones were grand.
She believed this completely and without irony, because the evidence of the last several seconds supported it rather than contradicted it.
They had fought against Relictus for eons.
Even though this Beast of Infinity had killed one of theirs and sent two Sororis Primas scrambling through light-years of contested territory, they had contained him.
And yet.

There was a foreboding quality in the air that Prabhavati could not dismiss, a specific atmospheric weight that her Superbius foundations registered as a preliminary signal without being able to identify the source with enough precision to act on the identification.
The Beast of Infinity kept his eyes on her.
The mad crystalline blue of them did not waver.
Did not survey the chains or assess the surrounding Gilded Ones.
Just...her.
His jaws opened.
"Pride?" The voice that came out carried the harmonic depth of a form built to project.
"Wrath?
Superbius?
Ira?"
A sound emerged that was technically laughter and contained zero warmth.
"You know nothing of true Pride.
You know nothing of SUPERBIUS!"
BOOM!
Prabhavati saw it bloom from within him.

Golden Pride rose from the Beast of Infinity’s foundations and she experienced the specific vertigo of a Superbius Gilded One encountering an expression of their own foundational Ego in a configuration that exceeded what their own engineering had ever produced.
It was not the engineered Superbius of the Gilded caste system, refined across generations.

It was something rawer and grander and more fundamental, as though someone had gone back to the source from which the Gilded engineering was derived and drawn directly from it rather than through the derived methodology.
It felt purer than her own.
The thought arrived and she rejected it and it returned!

The golden glow spread outward from his body and wrapped around the chains holding him, and where the glow touched chain, the chain’s resistance registered his Pride as a legitimate authority rather than a force to be opposed!

Dozens of chains came apart simultaneously, the structural integrity of their collective foundation failing not because his strength had exceeded it but because the Pride he was broadcasting had convinced the weavings that they were not in the presence of something they should be restraining.
He pulled on the remaining chains.
He took a step.
It felt like...an Infinite Step.

Prabhavati had time to register that he had closed every meter of the distance between them in no time at all before she registered anything else, and what she registered next was pressure at her chest, the specific pressure of something that had bypassed her defensive weavings completely.
His claws pierced through.
Her Heart of Civilization shattered.

The pain was absolute and immediate and total in the way that only existential damage at this particular location produced, the Heart not being merely an organ but being the anchor point of everything her Civilization was built upon, and its shattering sent fractures through every adjacent structure simultaneously.
And The Beast of Infinity...
He was smiling!
Brutally, completely!
His jaws opened wide.

She felt herself taken in, felt the jaws close around her Gilded existence with the comprehensive finality of an ending, her foundations beginning to break down under the devouring pressure of Infinity that consumed rather than coexisted.
Blood and bone registered distantly, the sensations of her Gilded physiology failing under conditions it had not been engineered to survive.
The warmth of her own ichor.
The grinding texture of structures that had held for eons giving way.
She.
A Sororis Prima of THE Magna Sorora.
Was dying?
She had not conceived of this outcome as a genuine possibility...ever.

His terrible golden Pride strained against the new chains.
The chains held at the edges of what holding meant.
But the darkness was already coming for Prabhavati.
Inexorable and patient!
And before he final femtoseconds, she heard...
"You shouldn’t...have tried to kill and replace me with your Custos."
BOOM!
Her consciousness wavered as she held a realization, but...it was too late!

chapters.title: Chapter 5220: Glory! I
paragraphs: In the Infiniverse, where golden sands dreamed beneath seas of multicolored Infinity, the heartbeats had multiplied.

Above the endless sea, singularities of beating hearts floated in their millions, each one pulsing with the steady rhythm of a foundation that had been engineered to survive what ordinary foundations could not. Above those hearts, dozens of forms hung suspended in the Infinity-rich air, their bodies soaking in the multicolored currents that surged upward from the sea below and permeated their newly transformed existences.

They were smaller than THE Primus Apeiron. Slightly. The scales were present, the horns, the tails, the dorsal protrusions, all of it present but carrying the specific quality of forms that had been derived from a primary template rather than being the template itself. Where Noah’s Primus Apeiron form blazed with the full density of Nearu Absolute Infinity, these carried the concentrated but comparatively modest Infinity of his people, each one burning with whatever foundation they had brought into the engineering and whatever the engineering had made of that foundation.

Naldine’s form carried rivers of golden light between its scales. Arch Lich Ra’Zan’s carried the deep cold luminescence of something ancient that had been given a new body to inhabit. Henry’s carried the blue-gold that ran through everything the Osmont bloodline touched. Barbatos’s was compact and precise, the specific quality of someone who had always been more dangerous than their size suggested.
Ul’moreth’s Apeiron was filled with a hairy golden exterior!
They began to wake.

Ruination looked at all of them with shining eyes, her crimson-blue illusory form moving slowly through their suspended ranks with the calm authority of a system intelligence that had received its operational parameters and was ready to deliver them.

|All of this exists for adversity and challenge to propagate growth and progression. Because without growth, we will eventually be stifled. All of you are unfathomably weaker against the beings you will face. You may be collapsed in a single engagement. If not collapsed, they may attempt to capture you.|
Her voice carried cold tyrannical precision.
|You will not allow capture. Inside your Apeiron engineering, there are weavings for a final measure. When your collapse becomes inevitable, you will activate THE Infinity Kilonova.|

|THE Infinity Kilonova: Upon activation or upon death, your Apeiron existence will detonate in a supernova of compressed Infinity that devours every trace of Infinity within a one-mile radius of the detonation point. Every being within that radius will find their Infinity reserves sapped, their Infinity channels temporarily severed. The detonation cannot be avoided. It cannot be contained. It occurs whether the enemy wishes it to or not. You are not merely soldiers.You are consequences.|
A pause.
|Go. Live and die. Feel Infinity and progress.|
Her eyes shone harder.
|Progress!|
BOOM!
Back in the Wandering Territories, Noah was pulling on the chains.

THE Absolute Superbius Ego of Infinity had ignited within his Primus Apeiron form, the golden Pride rising through his multicolored scales and pressing outward against the chain configuration with the specific authority of a being whose Ego had been taken to its Absolute expression, and the power it produced made the earlier Superbius display feel like a preliminary announcement before the main declaration. Several chains had already come apart.

The ones remaining held because hundreds of Gilded Ones were collectively refusing to release them, their Ira foundations locked in coordinated tension, their Superbius commanders issuing cold synchronised commands that kept the configuration from developing the weak points that would allow a single sustained pull to unravel the whole arrangement.
The Gilded Ones moved with practiced efficiency.

They had fought Relictus. They had protocols for exactly this category of contained threat, and they were executing those protocols with the precision of beings who had learned through eons that precision was the difference between a successful containment and a catastrophe.
Then... the other Apeiron appeared!
Dozens of them. Smaller. Emerging from points of multicolored brilliance throughout the Wandering Territories around the containment perimeter!
The shock moved through the assembled Gilded Ones in a single visible wave.

A Superbius Gilded One on the outer perimeter moved before thinking, the reflex of a being whose Pride had encountered a provocation before their cognition had processed whether the response was strategically appropriate.

His Existential Radiation erupted outward toward the nearest newly arrived Apeiron with the full authority of Paleozoic Scale Superbius engineering behind it, the crushing pressure of genuine Gilded Pride descending on a form that had not been designed to survive direct engagement with that tier of force.
The Apeiron in question happened to be THE Emperor Penguin.
The pressure came down.

THE Emperor Penguin’s Apeiron form was flattened immediately, the Paleozoic Scale differential producing exactly the outcome that the differential between those two tiers always produced when applied without restraint, the smaller form compressed into the Wandering Territories’ multicolored sea under weight it had no answer for.
The Superbius Gilded One registered the ease of it with the specific satisfaction of a being confirming that the situation was more manageable than it had briefly appeared.
And then THE Emperor Penguin detonated.
THE Infinity Kilonova!

The explosion expanded outward from the collapse point in a sphere of devouring Infinity that did not discriminate between friend and threat, did not slow against defensive weavings, did not acknowledge the Paleozoic tier of the beings within its one-mile radius as a relevant variable in its operation.

The Superbius Gilded One who had caused the collapse felt their Infinity reserves evacuate through channels they could not close, pulled outward into the detonation’s consumption field with the comprehensive efficiency of the Apeiron engineering’s final capability!

Dozens of Gilded Ones within the radius felt the same evacuation, their cultivation capacity dropping with the sudden disorientation of beings whose primary substrate had just been meaningfully reduced.
They felt significantly weaker!
Then another newly arrived Apeiron was collapsed by an Ira warrior who had moved to eliminate the small disturbances at the perimeter.
Another Kilonova.
Another mile radius of Infinity consumption.

Then another. And another, the pattern establishing itself with the relentless patience of an attrition strategy that had been designed with full awareness that individual losses were not failures but mechanisms, each collapse producing a detonation that degraded the surrounding Gilded Ones’ capacity while the Infiniverse rebuilt and returned what had been lost.

The Gilded Ones found the newly appearing Beasts of Infinity weaker. Easier to collapse. They collapsed them readily, efficiently, with the practiced confidence of beings addressing a manageable nuisance.
But...
Every collapse devoured their Infinity!

chapters.title: Chapter 5221: Glory! II
paragraphs: The chains holding Noah began to slacken at their ends.

The Gilded Ones holding them were weaker than they had been thirty seconds ago, their collective tension reduced by the compound effect of multiple Kilonova detonations pulling at the Infinity that powered the chain configuration’s resistance. Noah felt the slackening in his palms and pulled.
The chains came toward him!

Dozens of Ira warriors were dragged forward by the collective mass of chain that Noah’s Primus Apeiron strength was now pulling against a resistance that had been meaningfully degraded, their footing lost, their coordinated formation breaking as individual Gilded Ones were forced toward the being they had been successfully containing seconds earlier!
His tail struck outward, finding the Ira warriors as they closed involuntarily against their will, skewering multiple in a single arc before the tail withdrew and struck again!
HUUM!
His jaws opened, taking what was closest, the crimson-gold blood reappearing at the corners of his mouth as his Infinity Devour processed the intake!
The devastation spread outward from his position in the specific manner of a confined storm that had just found a gap in its walls.
A storm!
Truly a storm!

Newly appearing Apeiron continued materializing throughout the region, each arrival adding to the chaos that the Kilonova chain was producing, each collapse feeding the next detonation, the compound effect degrading the Gilded assembly’s overall capacity in increments that individually seemed manageable and collectively were not.
It was, Noah’s Hadean Mind registered with the dry appreciation of a being watching their own design perform correctly under field conditions, working exactly as intended.
And then...something entered Observable Existence.
BOOM!
Space above the Wandering Territories shattered.

Not cracked. Shattered, the specific destruction of a medium that had been traversed at a speed for which the medium had not been given adequate preparation time, the dimensional fabric coming apart in the wake of something that had moved through it faster than the fabric’s self-repair capacity could compensate for.
A crimson light flashed across the entire region in a single instant that covered every coordinate simultaneously, and when the crimson light settled...the before and after had nothing in common.
Noah’s right shoulder and hand were gone.

Not struck. Not damaged. Scorched away and atrophied, the remains of the limb ending at a cauterized terminus that his Apeiron engineering was already attempting to address through its regenerative protocols.

The pain registered in full. The Apeiron engineering had not been designed to filter pain because pain was the mechanism. He felt every femtosecond of the limb’s removal as he had to feel this adversity!
Inches away, having covered whatever distance separated their prior positions and his current position in the interval the crimson flash had occupied, stood a newly arrived Gilded One.

Large. Muscular in the way of a being whose body had been built around the specific purpose of ending things, his frame raging with Ira authority that operated at a tier above every other Ira presence in the Wandering Territories by a margin that registered immediately and comprehensively.
His smile was brutal and familiar in a way that made no immediate sense given that Noah had no prior record of this specific face.
Not Ordovician Paleozoic.

Silurian Paleozoic. The second tier of THE Third Scale, carrying the specific density of a being whose cultivation had been compressing Paleozoic authority into his foundations for long enough that the compression had become the default state rather than the achieved one.
"Buddy boy."
The voice carried the specific cadence of someone who used this address habitually and found it adequate for all occasions.
"You’ve caused quite the mess here."The brutal smile did not move. "Who are you?"
The mannerisms. The address. The specific quality of casual brutality delivered through the voice of someone who genuinely found the circumstances entertaining.
Noah did not know, but this was seemingly an identical copy of a being who was, at this precise moment, engaging THE Creature in THE Undefined Gaps at the same time!
|Entity Identification: Prima Custos Ragnar V49.|
Pillow Talk extended the notification.
|The subject is a cloned and engineered Ira Gilded One, of which there are many.|
BOOM!

The power of two Prime Causes erupted from Prima Custos Ragnar V49’s form simultaneously, THE Dominion Cause and THE Bellum Cause blazing in both massive hands with the compound authority of a being who had been pulling from Prime Cause substrates long enough that the pulling was as natural as breathing.

His hands thundered downward with the full weight of both Causes behind them, the impact trajectory covering every spatial coordinate Noah’s remaining limbs occupied with the comprehensive certainty of a being who had done this many times!
"Haha, buddy boy, no words?"
The smile widened.
"Come on now!"
BOOM!
Noah moved first.

THE Infinite Step collapsed the distance between his position and Ragnar V49’s in the same instant the Prime Cause eruptions were still propagating outward from the massive hands, and his remaining clawed hand drove into the gap between the Causes’ trajectories with the full compound force of his Bellum Cause rings and his Apeiron engineering behind it, the crimson rings burning at maximum intensity around his forearm as the strike targeted the one coordinate Ragnar’s attack pattern had briefly vacated!
BOOM!
The contact landed.
Ragnar’s body did not move.

He just did not register the impact in any way that a body registers impacts, the force of Noah’s strike absorbing into Ragnar’s frame the way sound absorbs into dense material, present and then simply gone, the Silurian Paleozoic body having decided that what had just hit it was insufficient information to act on.
"Oh, there we go!"Ragnar’s smile broadened with genuine delight. "Hit me again, buddy boy, I could barely feel that one!"
Noah hit him again.

His tail drove into Ragnar’s midsection simultaneously, the spear-point of compressed Infinity at its tip delivering the full density of THE Infinity Devour on contact, attempting to pull Ragnar’s reserves outward through the impact point the way it had pulled Prabhavati’s Silurian Light apart earlier in the engagement!
HUUM!
There was nothing to pull.
"Haha, I was already briefed about you, buddy boy! No infinity in me right now!"
WAA!
Ragnar carried no Infinity reserves at this moment. His foundations did not operate through the Infinity substrate that the Devour capability had been designed to consume.

He drew on THE Dominion Cause and THE Bellum Cause directly, Prime Cause authority flowing through him as an integrated component of his existence rather than as an accessed resource, and Prime Cause authority at this level of integration had no Infinity surface for Noah’s engineering to grip.
The tail retracted as Ragnar moved!
BOOM!

The speed was the first genuinely new thing Noah had encountered as it seemed almost as fast if not faster than even Ubergulden Dietrich. Not fast in the way that Ordovician Paleozoic beings were fast, which was fast enough to require his Hadean Mind to stretch instants into extended perception to track!
Ragnar’s fist found Noah’s left side before Noah’s extended perception had completed its calculation of where Ragnar’s fist was going.
BOOM!

The impact drove him through the multicolored sea below for light years and through several layers of the Wandering Territories’ substrate beneath that, the force carrying through his Apeiron scales with enough residual power that the sixty percent Cause resistance his engineering provided absorbed its portion and the remaining forty percent registered through his foundations in full!
And yet...
WAA!
He was back before the crater finished forming.

THE Infinite Step. He emerged from the detonation point and drove both the crimson Bellum swords orbiting his form directly at Ragnar’s neck and chest simultaneously, redirecting their orbital paths into converging attack vectors while his remaining hand released a concentrated stream of Infinity singularities at point-blank range, filling the space between them with scorching projectiles that covered every escape vector Ragnar’s body occupied!
The swords bent around Ragnar’s neck without cutting!
Oh!
OH!
The singularities detonated against his chest and produced a brief flash of light and nothing else!

"That tickled a little, buddy boy" Ragnar reached out with one hand and caught one of the orbiting crimson swords mid-path, his grip closing around the Bellum Cause weapon with the casual confidence of a being for whom the Cause the weapon drew from was a native language rather than a foreign one.
He looked at it with genuine appreciation. "You’ve actually touched THE Bellum Cause, haven’t you? A Bounded thing with access to a Prime Cause." He turned the sword once in his grip.
"Fascinating. Genuinely fascinating. I’ll have to crack your foundations open later and see how you managed that!"
He released the sword and hit Noah with it.
BOOM!

The impact sent Noah spinning through the air above the Wandering Territories, the specific rotational quality of being struck by one’s own weapon carrying an insult that the pain intensified. His multicolored scales cracked!
Noah righted himself.

He activated THE Absolute Superbius Ego simultaneously with his Apeiron form rather than replacing one with the other, the two expressions running in parallel, the golden Pride of Absolute Superbius pressing outward from his scaled form as he drove directly at Ragnar with every ounce of compound authority his current configuration could produce.
The golden Pride washed over Ragnar.
Ragnar...walked through it.
"Superbius?" He looked at the golden light covering his body with the expression of a being who had spent eons operating within Superbius authority and found its presence about as notable as weather.
"I work for THE Ubergulden House, buddy boy. I’ve been bathing in Superbius Pride since before your conception was a possibility anyone had considered."
BOOM!
He grabbed Noah by the remaining arm.

What followed was not a sustained engagement in the conventional sense. It was systematic. Ragnar moved with the specific efficiency of a being who had assessed the situation, determined the most direct path to the desired outcome, and was executing that path without stylistic flourishes.
He drove Noah into the Wandering Territories’ substrate face-first!
BOOM!
Pulled him out!
BOOM!
Drove him in again from a different angle.

"You’re sturdy for something that shouldn’t be standing at Paleozoic Scale at all," Ragnar said conversationally, his grip maintaining its hold through Noah’s attempts to use THE Infinite Step to disengage.
"Whatever you are, you’ve got conviction! CON! VIC! TION! Haha, Buddy boy, you’ve got more conviction than half the Ira I’ve beaten up, and I’ve beaten a lot of Ira."

He swung Noah into a cluster of the remaining Gilded Ones who had been maintaining the chain perimeter, the bodies scattering outward from the impact zone like fucking bowling bowls as many grumbled, but only moved away as if even they wanted to avoid Ragnar!
THE Infinite Step brought Noah back as he continued relentlessly, treating this as adversity!
So what if he was being beaten? Being beaten wss another form of training and adversity as he would grow from it! Until even this impossible mountain of Ragnar...would be overcome!
BOOM!

He hit Ragnar from behind with both Bellum Cause swords fully empowered, the crimson lightning arcing across the impact surface, THE Infinity Devour reaching for anything in Ragnar’s foundations that the capability could grip, his tail and his clawed hand and the Absolute Superbius all operating simultaneously at full output as his invisible Pillar of Infinity blazed!
Ragnar turned around languidly amidst all this and...
BOOM!

THE Dominion Cause erupted from his left hand, the authority that existence arranges itself into hierarchies pressing down on Noah’s foundations with the foundational weight of a truth that had been present since before the Gilded Ones had existed to channel it. Noah’s Apeiron scales absorbed sixty percent. The remaining forty percent hit his Civilization, his Cause connections, his Hadean Pillar’s accumulated authority, and pressed all of it toward a lower position in the hierarchy the Cause was asserting.

THE Bellum Cause erupted from Ragnar’s right hand simultaneously, the foundational truth of conflict expressing itself through the specific application of a being who had incorporated it into his existence so thoroughly that deploying it was simply a matter of deciding where to point what he already was.
The two Causes together converged on Noah’s Primus Apeiron form!
Noah met it.

He met it with everything. His Infinity! His Civilizations! THE Absolute Superbius Pride pushed back against THE Dominion Cause’s hierarchical assertion with the full weight of its own sovereign declaration!
For a single extended moment, the outputs balanced!
It was shocking! He, who should barely be in THE Ordovician Paleozoic Scale in terms of power, stood against a monstrous Silurian!
Ragnar looked at him across the convergence point with an expression of genuine surprise, the brutal smile present but different!
"Buddy boy..."he said.
Then he pushed harder.
The balance broke.

Noah’s defenses came apart in the specific sequence of a structure that had been holding beyond its rated capacity and had finally encountered the force that exceeded what holding beyond capacity could accommodate. The Bellum swords were bounced away. His remaining hand was caught. His tail was pinned!
Ragnar looked at him from close range and smiled with a sense of...mad thrill and ecstasy.
He took Noah’s head in one hand and his legs in the other, and...
He pulled.

The sound that followed was the sound of an existence being separated from itself against its will, the specific register of damage that Apeiron engineering had been designed to transmit in full because full transmission was the mechanism, and Noah felt every detail of the separation with the comprehensive clarity!
He felt all the pain!
He gazed at Ragnar coldly and completely, thanking this masochistic fucker for this adversity!
Ragnar held both halves and looked at him with something that was almost respect.
"See you next time, buddy boy. In another life..."
BOOM!
Before Ragnar finished talking, Noah’s existence exploded!
The explosion that followed was not a Kilonova.

The Apeiron engineering had been designed for the one-mile standard. What detonated from the Primus Apeiron’s collapse was not standard. It was the full accumulated reserves of Nearu Absolute Infinity that had been compressed into the Primus Apeiron form across the entire engagement, the Infinity Devour’s total intake from Prabhavati and her colleagues and every Gilded One the engagement had touched, the compound weight of everything Noah had consumed and generated and drawn from Adelheid’s bond throughout the past minutes, all of it releasing simultaneously from a single point in the Wandering Territories in a sphere that did not stop at one mile.
It did not stop at one light-year.

The detonation expanded outward at the speed that things moving outward from a Primus Apeiron collapse expanded, which was faster than the Gilded Ones present had any framework to respond to, and the radius it covered before the detonation’s energy was finally distributed across sufficient volume to dissipate was anentire gigaparsec.
Every Gilded One within that gigaparsec felt their Infinity leave them.

Not reduced. Not diminished. Departed, pulled outward through every channel they possessed by the Infinity Devour that the explosion had distributed across every point within its radius simultaneously, their cultivation capacity dropping with the sudden sick disorientation!
Prima Custos Ragnar V49 looked at the dissipating detonation with a furiously ecstatic gaze as from him...crimson gold blood gushed out!
A dying enemy...had wounded him!

sentences.text: The chains holding Noah began to slacken at their ends.

The Gilded Ones holding them were weaker than they had been thirty seconds ago, their collective tension reduced by the compound effect of multiple Kilonova detonations pulling at the Infinity that powered the chain configuration’s resistance.
Noah felt the slackening in his palms and pulled.
The chains came toward him!

Dozens of Ira warriors were dragged forward by the collective mass of chain that Noah’s Primus Apeiron strength was now pulling against a resistance that had been meaningfully degraded, their footing lost, their coordinated formation breaking as individual Gilded Ones were forced toward the being they had been successfully containing seconds earlier!
His tail struck outward, finding the Ira warriors as they closed involuntarily against their will, skewering multiple in a single arc before the tail withdrew and struck again!
HUUM!
His jaws opened, taking what was closest, the crimson-gold blood reappearing at the corners of his mouth as his Infinity Devour processed the intake!
The devastation spread outward from his position in the specific manner of a confined storm that had just found a gap in its walls.
A storm!
Truly a storm!

Newly appearing Apeiron continued materializing throughout the region, each arrival adding to the chaos that the Kilonova chain was producing, each collapse feeding the next detonation, the compound effect degrading the Gilded assembly’s overall capacity in increments that individually seemed manageable and collectively were not.
It was, Noah’s Hadean Mind registered with the dry appreciation of a being watching their own design perform correctly under field conditions, working exactly as intended.
And then...something entered Observable Existence.
BOOM!
Space above the Wandering Territories shattered.
Not cracked.

Shattered, the specific destruction of a medium that had been traversed at a speed for which the medium had not been given adequate preparation time, the dimensional fabric coming apart in the wake of something that had moved through it faster than the fabric’s self-repair capacity could compensate for.
A crimson light flashed across the entire region in a single instant that covered every coordinate simultaneously, and when the crimson light settled...the before and after had nothing in common.
Noah’s right shoulder and hand were gone.
Not struck.
Not damaged.
Scorched away and atrophied, the remains of the limb ending at a cauterized terminus that his Apeiron engineering was already attempting to address through its regenerative protocols.
The pain registered in full.
The Apeiron engineering had not been designed to filter pain because pain was the mechanism.
He felt every femtosecond of the limb’s removal as he had to feel this adversity!
Inches away, having covered whatever distance separated their prior positions and his current position in the interval the crimson flash had occupied, stood a newly arrived Gilded One.
Large.

Muscular in the way of a being whose body had been built around the specific purpose of ending things, his frame raging with Ira authority that operated at a tier above every other Ira presence in the Wandering Territories by a margin that registered immediately and comprehensively.
His smile was brutal and familiar in a way that made no immediate sense given that Noah had no prior record of this specific face.
Not Ordovician Paleozoic.
Silurian Paleozoic.

The second tier of THE Third Scale, carrying the specific density of a being whose cultivation had been compressing Paleozoic authority into his foundations for long enough that the compression had become the default state rather than the achieved one.
"Buddy boy."
The voice carried the specific cadence of someone who used this address habitually and found it adequate for all occasions.
"You’ve caused quite the mess here."The brutal smile did not move.
"Who are you?"
The mannerisms.
The address.
The specific quality of casual brutality delivered through the voice of someone who genuinely found the circumstances entertaining.
Noah did not know, but this was seemingly an identical copy of a being who was, at this precise moment, engaging THE Creature in THE Undefined Gaps at the same time!
|Entity Identification: Prima Custos Ragnar V49.|
Pillow Talk extended the notification.
|The subject is a cloned and engineered Ira Gilded One, of which there are many.|
BOOM!

The power of two Prime Causes erupted from Prima Custos Ragnar V49’s form simultaneously, THE Dominion Cause and THE Bellum Cause blazing in both massive hands with the compound authority of a being who had been pulling from Prime Cause substrates long enough that the pulling was as natural as breathing.

His hands thundered downward with the full weight of both Causes behind them, the impact trajectory covering every spatial coordinate Noah’s remaining limbs occupied with the comprehensive certainty of a being who had done this many times!
"Haha, buddy boy, no words?"
The smile widened.
"Come on now!"
BOOM!
Noah moved first.

THE Infinite Step collapsed the distance between his position and Ragnar V49’s in the same instant the Prime Cause eruptions were still propagating outward from the massive hands, and his remaining clawed hand drove into the gap between the Causes’ trajectories with the full compound force of his Bellum Cause rings and his Apeiron engineering behind it, the crimson rings burning at maximum intensity around his forearm as the strike targeted the one coordinate Ragnar’s attack pattern had briefly vacated!
BOOM!
The contact landed.
Ragnar’s body did not move.

He just did not register the impact in any way that a body registers impacts, the force of Noah’s strike absorbing into Ragnar’s frame the way sound absorbs into dense material, present and then simply gone, the Silurian Paleozoic body having decided that what had just hit it was insufficient information to act on.
"Oh, there we go!"Ragnar’s smile broadened with genuine delight.
"Hit me again, buddy boy, I could barely feel that one!"
Noah hit him again.

His tail drove into Ragnar’s midsection simultaneously, the spear-point of compressed Infinity at its tip delivering the full density of THE Infinity Devour on contact, attempting to pull Ragnar’s reserves outward through the impact point the way it had pulled Prabhavati’s Silurian Light apart earlier in the engagement!
HUUM!
There was nothing to pull.
"Haha, I was already briefed about you, buddy boy!
No infinity in me right now!"
WAA!
Ragnar carried no Infinity reserves at this moment.
His foundations did not operate through the Infinity substrate that the Devour capability had been designed to consume.

He drew on THE Dominion Cause and THE Bellum Cause directly, Prime Cause authority flowing through him as an integrated component of his existence rather than as an accessed resource, and Prime Cause authority at this level of integration had no Infinity surface for Noah’s engineering to grip.
The tail retracted as Ragnar moved!
BOOM!
The speed was the first genuinely new thing Noah had encountered as it seemed almost as fast if not faster than even Ubergulden Dietrich.
Not fast in the way that Ordovician Paleozoic beings were fast, which was fast enough to require his Hadean Mind to stretch instants into extended perception to track!
Ragnar’s fist found Noah’s left side before Noah’s extended perception had completed its calculation of where Ragnar’s fist was going.
BOOM!

The impact drove him through the multicolored sea below for light years and through several layers of the Wandering Territories’ substrate beneath that, the force carrying through his Apeiron scales with enough residual power that the sixty percent Cause resistance his engineering provided absorbed its portion and the remaining forty percent registered through his foundations in full!
And yet...
WAA!
He was back before the crater finished forming.
THE Infinite Step.

He emerged from the detonation point and drove both the crimson Bellum swords orbiting his form directly at Ragnar’s neck and chest simultaneously, redirecting their orbital paths into converging attack vectors while his remaining hand released a concentrated stream of Infinity singularities at point-blank range, filling the space between them with scorching projectiles that covered every escape vector Ragnar’s body occupied!
The swords bent around Ragnar’s neck without cutting!
Oh!
OH!
The singularities detonated against his chest and produced a brief flash of light and nothing else!

"That tickled a little, buddy boy" Ragnar reached out with one hand and caught one of the orbiting crimson swords mid-path, his grip closing around the Bellum Cause weapon with the casual confidence of a being for whom the Cause the weapon drew from was a native language rather than a foreign one.
He looked at it with genuine appreciation.
"You’ve actually touched THE Bellum Cause, haven’t you?
A Bounded thing with access to a Prime Cause." He turned the sword once in his grip.
"Fascinating.
Genuinely fascinating.
I’ll have to crack your foundations open later and see how you managed that!"
He released the sword and hit Noah with it.
BOOM!
The impact sent Noah spinning through the air above the Wandering Territories, the specific rotational quality of being struck by one’s own weapon carrying an insult that the pain intensified.
His multicolored scales cracked!
Noah righted himself.

He activated THE Absolute Superbius Ego simultaneously with his Apeiron form rather than replacing one with the other, the two expressions running in parallel, the golden Pride of Absolute Superbius pressing outward from his scaled form as he drove directly at Ragnar with every ounce of compound authority his current configuration could produce.
The golden Pride washed over Ragnar.
Ragnar...walked through it.
"Superbius?" He looked at the golden light covering his body with the expression of a being who had spent eons operating within Superbius authority and found its presence about as notable as weather.
"I work for THE Ubergulden House, buddy boy.
I’ve been bathing in Superbius Pride since before your conception was a possibility anyone had considered."
BOOM!
He grabbed Noah by the remaining arm.
What followed was not a sustained engagement in the conventional sense.
It was systematic.
Ragnar moved with the specific efficiency of a being who had assessed the situation, determined the most direct path to the desired outcome, and was executing that path without stylistic flourishes.
He drove Noah into the Wandering Territories’ substrate face-first!
BOOM!
Pulled him out!
BOOM!
Drove him in again from a different angle.

"You’re sturdy for something that shouldn’t be standing at Paleozoic Scale at all," Ragnar said conversationally, his grip maintaining its hold through Noah’s attempts to use THE Infinite Step to disengage.
"Whatever you are, you’ve got conviction!
CON!
VIC!
TION!
Haha, Buddy boy, you’ve got more conviction than half the Ira I’ve beaten up, and I’ve beaten a lot of Ira."

He swung Noah into a cluster of the remaining Gilded Ones who had been maintaining the chain perimeter, the bodies scattering outward from the impact zone like fucking bowling bowls as many grumbled, but only moved away as if even they wanted to avoid Ragnar!
THE Infinite Step brought Noah back as he continued relentlessly, treating this as adversity!
So what if he was being beaten?
Being beaten wss another form of training and adversity as he would grow from it!
Until even this impossible mountain of Ragnar...would be overcome!
BOOM!

He hit Ragnar from behind with both Bellum Cause swords fully empowered, the crimson lightning arcing across the impact surface, THE Infinity Devour reaching for anything in Ragnar’s foundations that the capability could grip, his tail and his clawed hand and the Absolute Superbius all operating simultaneously at full output as his invisible Pillar of Infinity blazed!
Ragnar turned around languidly amidst all this and...
BOOM!

THE Dominion Cause erupted from his left hand, the authority that existence arranges itself into hierarchies pressing down on Noah’s foundations with the foundational weight of a truth that had been present since before the Gilded Ones had existed to channel it.
Noah’s Apeiron scales absorbed sixty percent.

The remaining forty percent hit his Civilization, his Cause connections, his Hadean Pillar’s accumulated authority, and pressed all of it toward a lower position in the hierarchy the Cause was asserting.

THE Bellum Cause erupted from Ragnar’s right hand simultaneously, the foundational truth of conflict expressing itself through the specific application of a being who had incorporated it into his existence so thoroughly that deploying it was simply a matter of deciding where to point what he already was.
The two Causes together converged on Noah’s Primus Apeiron form!
Noah met it.
He met it with everything.
His Infinity!
His Civilizations!
THE Absolute Superbius Pride pushed back against THE Dominion Cause’s hierarchical assertion with the full weight of its own sovereign declaration!

chapters.title: Chapter 5222: The Tongue! The Tongue!!! I
paragraphs: The warmth arrived first.

That glorious warmth of Infinity in its most concentrated state, pressing against every surface of his dissolving weavings with the patient embrace of a medium receiving something back into itself. Noah was smiling inside it!
A genuine smile, the specific expression of a being who had just had an extraordinarily good time doing something that had ended badly and was already mentally replanning the next attempt.
He replayed the battle.

The moment Ragnar’s fist had landed before his perception had finished calculating where Ragnar’s fist was going. The moment his tail had driven into Ragnar’s midsection and found nothing to devour because the man drew on Prime Causes rather than Infinity. The specific quality of being held and swung and driven face-first into the Wandering Territories.
He replayed it again.
And again.

The exhilaration was not diminished by the outcome. It was produced by the outcome, the specific pleasure of battle that had genuinely exceeded his current capacity and had shown him exactly where his current capacity ended and what the space beyond that ending looked like. He needed to know these things!
Calibration through comfortable engagements produced comfortable calibration. Calibration through Ragnar V49 produced brutal but accurate calibration.
He could feel his power across the brief duration of his recovery.

It had grown. Not dramatically. But measurably, genuinely, the foundations he had brought into THE Apeiron Hadean Organ of Infinity carrying a slightly different density than the foundations that had entered the engagement in the Wandering Territories.

THE Bellum Cause integration had deepened through the fight, the Prime Cause settling more naturally into his foundational architecture now that it had been tested under actual Paleozoic Scale pressure rather than only under Dreamstone contact.
He had to fight and war more to gain an even deeper integration!

The flow of Infinity through his Apeiron form had become more familiar, the Observable Force channels more responsive, the relationship between what he intended and what his body produced tightening toward the automatic that mastery produced.
Ten minutes.

That was his return window as THE Primus Apeiron. And the Gilded Ones in the Wandering Territories were currently sitting with significantly reduced Infinity reserves, the gigaparsec-radius detonation having reduced their cultivation capacity in ways they had not anticipated and could not immediately replenish.
They would not expect him to return. They had watched him get ripped apart. The reasonable assumption was that whatever he was, it was finished.
The singular obstacle was Ragnar.

He turned the entity over in his mind with the specific attention he gave to problems that had clear solutions that he hadn’t found yet. An Ira Gilded One operating at Silurian Paleozoic Scale, integrated with THE Dominion Cause and THE Bellum Cause at levels that made the Prime Cause authority a native expression of his foundations rather than an accessed capability.
No Infinity in his body for the Devour to grip. A body that treated Noah’s most powerful strikes as mild ambient information. Speed that bypassed the Hadean Mind’s perception extensions.

And behind Ragnar, a Superbius Gilded One who had not even entered the engagement, standing back with the cold composure of a being who had sent their instrument and found the instrument sufficient, which meant the being controlling Ragnar’s deployment was operating from a position of such genuine confidence that Ragnar’s capabilities had not prompted them to contribute.
Silurian Paleozoic beings were not to be underestimated!
Gilded Ones truly were genuinely powerful!

The other thing that sat in his mind was the specific detail Pillow Talk had delivered just before the collapse. Ragnar V49. Not Ragnar. V49, which implied a versioning system, which implied that V49 was the forty-ninth iteration of a cloned and engineered Ira Gilded One built to the same specifications.

Which meant there were at minimum forty-eight other versions of this entity somewhere in the broader arrangement, potentially hundreds, potentially a production methodology that could generate more on whatever timeline the engineering framework required.
The Gilded had manufactured dozens, possibly hundreds, of monsters at Ragnar’s level.
With the same face.
And this might only be the surface layer of what they actually held!

He breathed out, and multicolored rivers of Infinity came out with his breath, the exhale carrying the full density of Nearu Absolute Infinity in a visible current that illuminated the interior of THE Apeiron Hadean Organ of Infinity with shifting color.
There was a sensation he was becoming more familiar with in this elevated domain. Not quite vertigo. Moreso something like...the imposter syndrome.

The specific quality of a being who had arrived in a space where the other inhabitants had been present for billions of years, where the entities moving through the arrangements of power and politics and cultivation had been doing so across spans of time that made his entire history, from the first dungeon to this moment, fit inside a margin of error too small to be meaningful by their scale of measurement.
He had started as a man struggling against monsters in dungeons.

The distance between that and standing in Observable Existence fighting cloned Silurian Paleozoic Ira warriors while simultaneously occupying the lips of a Royal Gilded One inside a Magna Sorora vessel im THE Braneworld Observable Existence and touching Prime Cause Dreamstones in THE Sanctum Velanthra was a distance that, if any other mind had been required to hold it, would have collapsed under the weight of its own implications.

The idea alone, of going against beings who had been alive for eons, who had actively directed THE First Cause and its power while he had been learning how to produce a fireball, would crumble most minds before the engagement began.
He thought it freely.
"Hoooo."
He breathed out again, slower, the multicolored rivers of his breath dispersing into the warm Infinity surrounding him.
He had to remind himself every now and then he was not an imposter.
He belonged where he was. He fought to be where he was. He was just as grander...if not grander than the monsters that had lived for eons.

What if they were Gilded Ones? What if they steered THE First Cause itself? He was steering his own Infinite Cause. He had his own Scales. He had his own framework that operated outside every framework they had spent seven ages building!

He mattered. His dreams mattered. His ideals mattered. The Bounded woman his existence had come from mattered, her Infinite Cause originating something the Gilded had never managed to produce despite their eons and their engineering and their Prime Cause access and their seven ages of methodology!
He was ridiculously young in their terms.
That was not a weakness.
HUUM!

Infinity buzzed through the Organ as his form rebuilt with the specific quality of something returning grander than it had departed. The strength flowing outward confirmed it, the rebuilt Primus Apeiron configuration carrying the same measurable growth he had registered in his first moments of recovery, the battle’s adversity having done exactly what adversity was supposed to do.
He checked his other bodies.

One was in THE Braneworld Observable Existence, inside the Ubergulden vessel, in a situation that involved the specific risks of tasting the lips of a Royal Gilded One as he tasted her existence while surrounded by Magna Sorora and a Superbius brother who had recently attempted to throttle him.

A challenge and a risk of an entirely different category than Ragnar’s fists, but a challenge and a risk nonetheless, and the power augmentation flowing from the Primaris Bond was genuine regardless of the social danger of the context producing it.
One stood before THE Cognitio Dreamstone in THE Sanctum Velanthra, his palm making contact as the stone had begun to illuminate. Old Man Zeke was presumably watching.
Maybe before he returned to the Wandering Territories and resumed the battle with Ragnar, he would have another Prime Cause integrated into his foundations!

chapters.title: Chapter 5223: The Tongue! The Tongue!!! II
paragraphs: Ruination materialized inside THE Apeiron Hadean Organ of Infinity.

The interior of the Organ was warm with the Infinity currently rebuilding Noah’s Primus Apeiron form, multicolored currents flowing in slow steady patterns through the space around his dissolving and reforming weavings. Ruination’s crimson-blue illusory figure stood at the periphery of the rebuilding.
"Master."
Noah’s awareness oriented toward her without his form having completed its reconstruction.

"You devoured several Gilded Ones across this engagement. Their existential components have been processed through the Organ’s breakdown architecture.The breakdown is complete. Three grand singularities have formed. I present them now."
|Hadean Loot Singularities obtained from engagement in the Wandering Territories.|
|Processing complete. Three central singularities identified.|
|Hadean Loot Singularity- THE Gilded Ego Amalgam.|

|Source: The breakdown of multiple Gilded Ones across the Ira and Superbius designations, with the Ira component predominating due to the volume of Ira consumed. Their engineered Egos, their amplified Wrath and amplified Pride, their Hearts of Civilization and Organs of Dominion, have been compressed and amalgamated into a single grand singularity rather than remaining as separate fragments. The amalgamation was possible because Ego architecture, regardless of designation, operates through compatible foundational channels.|
|Effect upon consumption: Your three currently lit Absolute Egos of Infinity will each receive a meaningful amplification of their existing capabilities.|

|More significantly: The Ira component of this amalgamation is sufficient to ignite a fourth Absolute Ego configuration within THE Absolute Forge of Infinity. THE Absolute Ira Ego of Infinity will be lit for the first time upon integration, its foundational framework illuminated by the compressed Wrath of every Ira Gilded One consumed.|
|Hadean Loot Singularity- THE Sovereign Observable Organ.|

|Source: The Observable Force circulation organs of every Gilded One consumed during the engagement, amalgamated into a single grand singularity. Where ordinary Bounded beings access Observable Force through deliberate cultivation effort and even your prior Hadean engineering drew on Observable Force as an accessed resource, Gilded Ones absorb it automatically and continuously through dedicated organs that operate as a permanent passive intake regardless of whether the being is actively cultivating.|
|This singularity does not merely replicate that organ. It surpasses it.|

|Effect upon consumption: A new Hadean organ will form within your physiology. THE Hadean Sovereign Observable Organ will function as a permanent passive intake of ambient Observable Force, absorbing it continuously from the surrounding environment the way your lungs absorb air, requiring no deliberate cultivation draw and operating at full capacity even during active combat engagement when your conscious attention is occupied elsewhere.|

|In the lower Observable Existence, this organ will generate a steady baseline input that meaningfully supplements your existing reserves. In THE Braneworld Observable Existence, where Observable Force density exceeds the lower domains by orders of magnitude, the organ’s intake will be substantially greater, functioning in that environment as a near-continuous flood rather than a steady baseline.|

|The organ will additionally interface with the Primaris Bond you share with Ubergulden Adelheid. The passive intake and her active contribution through the Bond will no longer be separate streams requiring separate management. They will merge at the organ’s processing level and compound each other’s output, producing a combined Observable Force availability that exceeds what either source could provide independently by a significant factor.|
|Hadean Loot Singularity- THE Causal Comprehension Record.|

|Source: This singularity did not form through consumption alone. It formed through the compound of three distinct interactions with Cause authority across the engagement: the Pulses deployed by Ordovician Paleozoic Gilded Ones who drew on derived Causes and Prime Causes to cast structured expressions of THE Scales, and the contact residue left by Prima Custos Ragnar V49 whose simultaneous integration of THE Dominion Cause and THE Bellum Cause at Silurian Paleozoic level passed through your foundations during the ripping sequence.|
|This singularity is knowledge as loot. It cannot be expressed as a percentage increase or a capability unlock. It is comprehension.|

|Effect upon consumption: You will receive sparse but genuine knowledge of each Cause you encountered during the engagement, delivered in three distinct layers corresponding to the three tiers of Cause engagement you experienced.|
Ruination let the final notification settle.
"Three singularities," she said. "Each represents the most meaningful distillate of what the engagement produced."

Noah looked at the three singularities floating in the warm Infinity of the Organ, each one carrying its distinct quality, the Ego Amalgam’s golden-crimson warmth, the Sovereign Observable Organ’s dense golden shimmer, and the Causal Comprehension Record’s layered translucence that shifted between colors depending on which Cause’s residue was nearest to its surface.
He smiled as his hand rose out and he gently patted Ruination’s head.

The singularities flowed began dissolving into him one by one, and Noah sat in the warmth of the Organ and felt the shape of the next engagement with Ragnar already changing in the hands of a being who was becoming, with each passing second, slightly harder to rip apart.
In THE Braneworld Observable Existence.
The Cognitio Dreamstone received him differently than the Bellum stone had.
THE Bellum Cause had arrived like recognition, the specific comprehension of a being meeting the name for something they had always done.

THE Cognitio Cause arrived like doors opening inward, one behind another, each one revealing a space that contained another door, the experience of a Cause that did not deliver its truth as a single statement but as an architecture of understanding that expanded the further one walked into it.
Noah walked into it.
The vision...produced the two Relictus again.

The same glacial form he had seen through THE Bellum Dreamstone, its crystal plates catching and refracting the cold light of the snowy mountain, its body large and settled and operating in the specific rhythm of something that had been fighting long enough that fighting was simply its resting state.

The nine-headed serpentine being opposite it, its platinum crowns burning above each of the nine heads with the specific fire of something that had been lit so long ago that the lighting event was no longer part of its memory, only the burning itself.
They were fighting again.
But something was different!
They were losing.

Not to each other. To something he could not initially locate, a pressure that existed in the vision’s atmosphere as weight rather than as visible force, pressing down on both Relictus simultaneously from a direction that had no visible source.

The glacial Relictus’s crystal plates were cracking along lines they had not carried in the prior vision. The nine-headed one was missing two of its platinum crowns, the remaining seven burning at reduced intensity, the fire in them struggling against the same atmospheric pressure rather than expressing freely!

chapters.title: Chapter 5224: The Tongue! The Tongue!!! III
paragraphs: Both of them had wounds that were not healing between their Persevere declarations the way wounds had healed in the prior vision!

The word was still producing its recovery, still generating the surge of foundational power that rebuilt what had been lost, but the atmospheric pressure absorbed a portion of each recovery before it fully expressed, leaving both Relictus slightly less after each Persevere than they had been before the recovery, the accumulation of tiny deficits producing a slow trajectory toward something neither of them was going to be able to reverse through the same mechanism that had always worked before.
Then the glacial Relictus stopped.

It went still in a way that was different from the stillness of a being catching its breath between exchanges. It went still in the way of a being that had reached into their foundational substrate and found something there they had not previously reached deeply enough to find. A letter.
A single ancient letter from a Tongue.
The glacial Relictus opened its jaws.
"Exelissomai."
BOOM!
There were many unique words in existence that one could hear. The words uttered by entities utilizing the power of THE Primordial Source were always very unique!
The transformation was grand!

For the glacial Relictus, Exelissomai produced something interior, the change moving through the Relictus’s foundations rather than through its surface, restructuring the relationship between its power and its Primordial Source in a configuration that the atmospheric pressure had not anticipated and had no prepared response to.
The pressure stopped absorbing its recoveries.

The nine-headed Relictus observed what had happened, and in the way of beings who had been fighting beside and against each other long enough that certain kinds of communication did not require words, it understood. It found its own letter.
"Exelissomai."
HUUUM!

Both of them blazed with a renewed quality of power that was not the power of having recovered but the power of having accessed something they had not previously been drawing on, and the atmospheric pressure that had been winning now found itself engaged with beings who had reached the layer beneath the layer it had been suppressing.
Noah observed.

And as he observed, the Cognitio Cause delivered what the vision had been designed to deliver...through the layered comprehension of a Cause that understood that the deepest knowledge was not stated but structured into the arrangement of the information around it, each piece of the structure implying the next until the full architecture stood apparent without having been described directly.
He understood.

THE Primordial Source held THE Primordial Tongue.The letters, Persevere and Exelissomai, were letters of THE Primordial Tongue, the language of the substrate beneath Infinity, accessible to beings who had touched THE Primordial Source and survived the contact long enough to begin reading what it contained.
THE Relictus wielded this Tongue as their native language.

Infinity held... THE First Tongue. The structured language of the Infinite substrate that most beings who cultivated with Infinity accessed through their Civilizations, through their Pulses, through the derived frameworks they built atop Infinity’s foundational truth.

THE First Tongue was widespread. Countless Billions of beings across Existence drew on it in forms they recognized and forms they did not. It was the most commonly accessed language in the arrangement of existence, which was also why it was the language that most beings could only access partially, because a language that belonged to everyone equally belonged deeply to no one.
But.

THE Cognitio Cause knew something about THE First Tongue that the widespread access had obscured. The broad version of the language was not the only version. For beings whose entire existence had been saturated with Infinity so completely, so thoroughly, for so long and with such intentional depth, that the distinction between themselves and the Infinity they carried had become genuinely indistinguishable from the perspective of the Infinity itself, a deeper register of THE First Tongue became accessible.
Not THE First Tongue. THE Infinite Tongue.
The language of Infinity speaking through a being rather than being spoken by one.
Noah’s palm burned against the Cognitio Dreamstone as the comprehension arrived in full.

His entire existence was drenched in Infinity. From his Hadean Physiology, which had been rebuilt around Infinity as its foundational substrate, to his Hadean Pillar of Infinity, which contained hundreds of actualized Civilizations all expressing different truths through Infinity as their medium, to his Nearu Absolute Infinity state, which compressed a semblance of the Absolute into his every cell and organ continuously.
His existence did not access Infinity. His existence was Infinity expressing itself through a specific configuration that called itself Noah Osmont.
With the Cognitio Cause’s comprehension now backing and integrating into his foundations, the distinction he had never quite been able to articulate became formally recognized.
|THE Cognitio Dreamstone has delivered its comprehension.|
|You do not speak to Infinity. You do not wield Infinity. Your existence is the medium through which Infinity speaks, and you are the voice it uses.|
|Designation established: THE Infinite Speaker.|
|Access granted: THE Infinite Tongue.|
THE Tongue! THE Infinite Tongue!
Oh!
Information flowed freely!
|THE Infinite Tongue- First Level of Access.|

|THE Infinite Tongue operates through three foundational expressions at your current level of access. Deeper levels require further cultivation of both your Nearu Absolute Infinity and your Cognitio Cause integration.|
|First Expression- THE Infinite Vector:|

|Infinity in all its forms, whether your own or an external source, carriesdirection, magnitude, and intent.These properties are not fixed. They are expressions of how the Infinity is currently configured, and configurations can be rewritten by a being who speaks the Tongue that Infinity itself operates in.|

|THE Infinite Vector allows you to manipulate the direction, magnitude, and intent of any Infinity expression within your perceptual range, including your own, your allies’, your enemies’, and the ambient Infinity of the surrounding environment.An enemy’s Pulse, upon entering your perceptual range, can have its direction reversed back toward its source. Its magnitude can be amplified before it returns. Its intent can be rewritten so that it no longer carries the purpose its caster designed it to carry but instead carries the purpose you designate.|

|This operates passively for Infinity expressions directed at you, requiring no conscious activation, functioning as a continuous subconscious rewriting that your foundations perform as a natural expression of the Tongue. Active application extends this rewriting to any Infinity expression within range regardless of its target.|

|Critically: because this operates through speaking the Tongue that Infinity uses rather than through imposing an external force on Infinity from outside, it bypasses resistance frameworks that beings have built against Infinity manipulation. You are not forcing Infinity to change. You are simply telling it what it actually is, and Infinity, recognizing the Tongue, agrees.|
